From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.base.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.syntax.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.semantics.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.typing.

Import syntax.notations.

Import semantics.notations.

Import typing.notations.

Implicit Types (b : bool) (x X y Y : atom) (L : aset).

Definition trace_indistinguishable Σ e1 e2 : Prop :=
  forall n e1',
    Σ ⊨ e1 -->{n} e1' ->
    (exists e2', Σ ⊨ e2 -->{n} e2') /\
    (forall e2', Σ ⊨ e2 -->{n} e2' -> e1' ≈ e2').

Theorem obliviousness Σ e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
  Σ; e1 ▷ τ1 ->
  Σ; e2 ▷ τ2 ->
  e1 ≈ e2 ->
  trace_indistinguishable Σ e1 e2.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.base.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.syntax.

Import syntax.notations.

Implicit Types (b : bool).

Inductive wval : expr -> Prop :=
| WUnitV : wval <{ () }>
| WLit b : wval <{ lit b }>
| WPair v1 v2 : wval v1 -> wval v2 -> wval <{ (v1, v2) }>
| WAbs l τ e : wval <{ \:{l}τ => e }>
| WInj b τ v : wval v -> wval <{ inj@b<τ> v }>
| WFold X v : wval v -> wval <{ fold<X> v }>
| WBoxedLit b : wval <{ [b] }>
| WBoxedInj b ω v : otval ω -> oval v -> wval <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>
| WIf b v1 v2 :
    wval v1 -> wval v2 ->
    wval <{ ~if [b] then v1 else v2 }>
.

Inductive woval : expr -> Prop :=
| OWUnitV : woval <{ () }>
| OWBoxedLit b : woval <{ [b] }>
| OWPair v1 v2 : woval v1 -> woval v2 -> woval <{ (v1, v2) }>
| OWBoxedInj b ω v : otval ω -> oval v -> woval <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>
| OWIf b v1 v2 :
    woval v1 -> woval v2 ->
    woval <{ ~if [b] then v1 else v2 }>
.

Inductive ovalty : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
| OTUnit : ovalty <{ () }> <{ 𝟙 }>
| OTOBool b : ovalty <{ [b] }> <{ ~𝔹 }>
| OTProd v1 v2 ω1 ω2 :
    ovalty v1 ω1 -> ovalty v2 ω2 ->
    ovalty <{ (v1, v2) }> <{ ω1 * ω2 }>
| OTOSum b v ω1 ω2 :
    ovalty v <{ ite b ω1 ω2 }> ->

    otval <{ ite b ω2 ω1 }> ->
    ovalty <{ [inj@b<ω1 ~+ ω2> v] }> <{ ω1 ~+ ω2 }>
.

Variant ectx : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
| CtxProd1 τ2 : ectx (fun τ1 => <{ τ1 * τ2 }>)
| CtxProd2 ω1 : otval ω1 -> ectx (fun τ2 => <{ ω1 * τ2 }>)
| CtxOSum1 τ2 : ectx (fun τ1 => <{ τ1 ~+ τ2 }>)
| CtxOSum2 ω1 : otval ω1 -> ectx (fun τ2 => <{ ω1 ~+ τ2 }>)
| CtxApp1 v2 : wval v2 -> ectx (fun e1 => <{ e1 v2 }>)
| CtxApp2 e1 : ectx (fun e2 => <{ e1 e2 }>)
| CtxLet e2 : ectx (fun e1 => <{ let e1 in e2 }>)
| CtxSec : ectx (fun e => <{ s𝔹 e }>)
| CtxIf e1 e2 : ectx (fun e0 => <{ if e0 then e1 else e2 }>)
| CtxOIf1 e1 e2 : ectx (fun e0 => <{ ~if e0 then e1 else e2 }>)
| CtxOIf2 v0 e2 : wval v0 -> ectx (fun e1 => <{ ~if v0 then e1 else e2 }>)
| CtxOIf3 v0 v1 : wval v0 -> wval v1 -> ectx (fun e2 => <{ ~if v0 then v1 else e2 }>)
| CtxPair1 e2 : ectx (fun e1 => <{ (e1, e2) }>)
| CtxPair2 v1 : wval v1 -> ectx (fun e2 => <{ (v1, e2) }>)
| CtxProj b : ectx (fun e => <{ π@b e }>)
| CtxInj b τ : ectx (fun e => <{ inj@b<τ> e }>)
| CtxOInj1 b e : ectx (fun τ => <{ ~inj@b<τ> e }>)
| CtxOInj2 b ω : otval ω -> ectx (fun e => <{ ~inj@b<ω> e }>)
| CtxCase e1 e2: ectx (fun e0 => <{ case e0 of e1 | e2 }>)
| CtxOCase e1 e2: ectx (fun e0 => <{ ~case e0 of e1 | e2 }>)
| CtxFold X : ectx (fun e => <{ fold<X> e }>)
| CtxUnfold X : ectx (fun e => <{ unfold<X> e }>)
| CtxTape : ectx (fun e => <{ tape e }>)
| CtxMux1 e1 e2 : ectx (fun e0 => <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }>)
| CtxMux2 v0 e2 : wval v0 -> ectx (fun e1 => <{ mux v0 e1 e2 }>)
| CtxMux3 v0 v1 : wval v0 -> wval v1 -> ectx (fun e2 => <{ mux v0 v1 e2 }>)
.

Variant lectx : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
| LCtxApp v2 : wval v2 -> lectx (fun e1 => <{ e1 v2 }>)
| LCtxSec : lectx (fun e => <{ s𝔹 e }>)
| LCtxIf e1 e2 : lectx (fun e0 => <{ if e0 then e1 else e2 }>)
| LCtxProj b : lectx (fun e => <{ π@b e }>)
| LCtxCase e1 e2: lectx (fun e0 => <{ case e0 of e1 | e2 }>)
| LCtxUnfold X : lectx (fun e => <{ unfold<X> e }>)
.

Section step.

Context (Σ : gctx).

Reserved Notation "e '-->!' e'" (at level 40).

Inductive step : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
| SApp l τ e v :
    wval v ->
    <{ (\:{l}τ => e) v }> -->! <{ e^v }>
| SLet v e :
    wval v ->
    <{ let v in e }> -->! <{ e^v }>
| SIf b e1 e2 :
    <{ if b then e1 else e2 }> -->! <{ ite b e1 e2 }>
| SCase b τ v e1 e2 :
    wval v ->
    <{ case inj@b<τ> v of e1 | e2 }> -->! <{ ite b (e1^v) (e2^v) }>
| SProj b v1 v2 :
    wval v1 -> wval v2 ->
    <{ π@b (v1, v2) }> -->! <{ ite b v1 v2 }>
| SUnfold X X' v :
    wval v ->
    <{ unfold<X> (fold <X'> v) }> -->! v
| SFun x T e :
    Σ !! x = Some (DFun T e) ->
    <{ gvar x }> -->! <{ e }>
| SOADT X τ' τ v :
    wval v ->
    Σ !! X = Some (DOADT τ' τ) ->
    <{ (gvar X) v }> -->! <{ τ^v }>
| SSec b :
    <{ s𝔹 b }> -->! <{ [b] }>
| SOInj b ω v :
    otval ω -> oval v ->

385	with kinding : tctx -> expr -> kind -> Prop :=
386	| KADT Γ X τ :
387	    Σ !! X = Some (DADT τ) ->
388	    Γ ⊢ gvar X :: *@P
389	| KUnit Γ : Γ ⊢ 𝟙 :: *@A
390	| KBool Γ l : Γ ⊢ 𝔹{l} :: ite l *@O *@P
391	| KPi Γ l τ1 τ2 κ1 κ2 L :
392	    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(l, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ τ2^x :: κ2) ->
393	    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: κ1 ->
394	    Γ ⊢ (Π:{l}τ1, τ2) :: *@M
395	| KProd Γ τ1 τ2 κ :
396	    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: κ ->
397	    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: κ ->
398	    Γ ⊢ τ1 * τ2 :: κ
399	| KSum Γ τ1 τ2 κ :
400	    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: κ ->
401	    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: κ ->
402	    Γ ⊢ τ1 + τ2 :: (κ ⊔ *@P)
403	| KOSum Γ τ1 τ2 :
404	    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: *@O ->
405	    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: *@O ->
406	    Γ ⊢ τ1 ~+ τ2 :: *@O
407	| KOADT Γ e' e τ X :
408	    Σ !! X = Some (DOADT τ e') ->
409	    Γ ⊢ e :{⊥} τ ->
410	    Γ ⊢ (gvar X) e :: *@O
411	| KIf Γ e0 τ1 τ2 :
412	    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} 𝔹 ->
413	    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: *@O ->
414	    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: *@O ->
415	    Γ ⊢ if e0 then τ1 else τ2 :: *@O
416	| KCase Γ e0 τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' L1 L2 :
417	    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} τ1' + τ2' ->
418	    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ1')]>Γ ⊢ τ1^x :: *@O) ->
419	    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ2')]>Γ ⊢ τ2^x :: *@O) ->
420	    Γ ⊢ case e0 of τ1 | τ2 :: *@O
421	| KLet Γ e τ τ' L :
422	    Γ ⊢ e :{⊥} τ' ->
423	    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(⊥, τ')]>Γ ⊢ τ^x :: *@O) ->
424	    Γ ⊢ let e in τ :: *@O
425	| KSub Γ τ κ κ' :
426	    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ' ->
427	    κ' ⊑ κ ->
428	    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ
429	
430	where "Γ '⊢' e ':{' l '}' τ" := (typing Γ e l τ)
431	  and "Γ '⊢' τ '::' κ" := (kinding Γ τ κ)
432	.
433	
434	End fix_gctx.
435	
436	Scheme typing_kinding_ind := Minimality for typing Sort Prop
437	  with kinding_typing_ind := Minimality for kinding Sort Prop.
438	
439	Combined Scheme typing_kinding_mutind
440	         from typing_kinding_ind, kinding_typing_ind.
441	
442	Notation "Σ '⊢' e '≡' e'" := (pared_equiv Σ e e')
443	                               (at level 40,
444	                                e custom oadt at level 99,
445	                                e' custom oadt at level 99).
446	
447	Notation "Σ ; Γ '⊢' e ':{' l '}' τ" := (typing Σ Γ e l τ)
448	                                         (at level 40,
449	                                          Γ constr at level 0,
450	                                          e custom oadt at level 99,
451	                                          τ custom oadt at level 99,
452	                                          format "Σ ;  Γ  '⊢'  e  ':{' l '}'  τ").
453	
454	Notation "Σ ; Γ '⊢' τ '::' κ" := (kinding Σ Γ τ κ)
455	                                   (at level 40,
456	                                    Γ constr at level 0,
457	                                    τ custom oadt at level 99,
458	                                    κ custom oadt at level 99).
459	
460	Reserved Notation "Σ '⊢₁' D" (at level 40,
461	                               D constr at level 0).
462	
463	Inductive gdef_typing : gctx -> gdef -> Prop :=
464	| DTADT Σ τ :
465	    Σ; ∅ ⊢ τ :: *@P ->
466	    Σ ⊢₁ (DADT τ)
467	| DTOADT Σ τ e L :
468	    Σ; ∅ ⊢ τ :: *@P ->
469	    (forall x, x ∉ L -> Σ; ({[x:=(⊥, τ)]}) ⊢ e^x :: *@O) ->
470	    Σ ⊢₁ (DOADT τ e)
471	| DTFun Σ l τ e κ :
472	    Σ; ∅ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
473	    Σ; ∅ ⊢ e :{l} τ ->
474	    Σ ⊢₁ (DFun (l, τ) e)
475	
476	where "Σ '⊢₁' D" := (gdef_typing Σ D)
477	.
478	
479	Definition gctx_typing (Σ : gctx) : Prop :=
480	  map_Forall (fun _ D => Σ ⊢₁ D) Σ.
481	
482	Definition program_typing (Σ : gctx) (e : expr) (τ : expr) :=
483	  gctx_typing Σ /\ Σ; ∅ ⊢ e :{⊥} τ.
484	
485	End typing.
486	
487	Module notations.
488	
489	Export kind_notations.
490	
491	Notation "Σ '⊢' e '⇛' e'" := (pared Σ e e')
492	                                  (at level 40,
493	                                   e custom oadt at level 99,
494	                                   e' custom oadt at level 99).
495	
496	Notation "Σ '⊢' e '⇛*' e'" := (rtc (pared Σ) e e')
497	                                  (at level 40,
498	                                   e custom oadt at level 99,
499	                                   e' custom oadt at level 99).
500	
501	Notation "Σ '⊢' e '≡' e'" := (pared_equiv Σ e e')
502	                               (at level 40,
503	                                e custom oadt at level 99,
504	                                e' custom oadt at level 99).
505	
506	Notation "Σ ; Γ '⊢' e ':{' l '}' τ" := (typing Σ Γ e l τ)
507	                                         (at level 40,
508	                                          Γ constr at level 0,
509	                                          e custom oadt at level 99,
510	                                          l constr at level 99,
511	                                          τ custom oadt at level 99,
512	                                          format "Σ ;  Γ  '⊢'  e  ':{' l '}'  τ").
513	
514	Notation "Σ ; Γ '⊢' e ':' τ" := (typing Σ Γ e _ τ)
515	                                         (at level 40,
516	                                          Γ constr at level 0,
517	                                          e custom oadt at level 99,
518	                                          τ custom oadt at level 99,
519	                                          only parsing).
520	
521	Notation "Σ ; Γ '⊢' τ '::' κ" := (kinding Σ Γ τ κ)
522	                                   (at level 40,
523	                                    Γ constr at level 0,
524	                                    τ custom oadt at level 99,
525	                                    κ custom oadt at level 99).
526	
527	Notation "Σ '⊢₁' D" := (gdef_typing Σ D) (at level 40,
528	                                          D constr at level 0).
529	
530	Notation "Σ ; e '▷' τ" := (program_typing Σ e τ)
531	                            (at level 40,
532	                             e constr at level 0,
533	                             τ constr at level 0).
534	
535	End notations.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.base.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.syntax.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.semantics.

Import syntax.notations.

Import semantics.notations.

Implicit Types (b : bool) (x X y Y : atom) (L : aset).

Variant kind :=
| KAny
| KPublic
| KObliv
| KMixed
.

Instance kind_join : Join kind :=
  fun κ1 κ2 =>
    match κ1, κ2 with
    | KAny, κ | κ, KAny => κ
    | KPublic, KObliv | KObliv, KPublic => KMixed
    | KMixed, _ | _, KMixed => KMixed
    | κ, _ => κ
    end.

Instance kind_le : SqSubsetEq kind :=
  fun κ1 κ2 => κ2 = (κ1 ⊔ κ2).

Instance kind_top : Top kind := KMixed.

Instance kind_bot : Bottom kind := KAny.

Notation tctx := (amap lexpr).

Module kind_notations.

Notation "*@A" := (KAny) (in custom oadt at level 0).

Notation "*@P" := (KPublic) (in custom oadt at level 0).

Notation "*@O" := (KObliv) (in custom oadt at level 0).

Notation "*@M" := (KMixed) (in custom oadt at level 0).

Infix "⊔" := (⊔) (in custom oadt at level 50).

End kind_notations.

Section typing.

Import kind_notations.

#[local]
Coercion EFVar : atom >-> expr.

Section fix_gctx.

Context (Σ : gctx).

Reserved Notation "e '⇛' e'" (at level 40,
                                 e' constr at level 0).

Inductive pared : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
| RApp l τ e1 e2 e1' e2' L :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    lc τ ->
    <{ (\:{l}τ => e2) e1 }> ⇛ <{ e2'^e1' }>
| RFun x T e :
    Σ !! x = Some (DFun T e) ->
    <{ gvar x }> ⇛ <{ e }>
| ROADT X τ' τ e e' :
    Σ !! X = Some (DOADT τ' τ) ->
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ (gvar X) e }> ⇛ <{ τ^e' }>
| RLet e1 e2 e1' e2' L :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    <{ let e1 in e2 }> ⇛ <{ e2'^e1' }>
| RProj b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ π@b (e1, e2) }> ⇛ <{ ite b e1' e2' }>
| RFold X X' e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ unfold<X> (fold<X'> e) }> ⇛ e'
| RIf b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ if b then e1 else e2 }> ⇛ <{ ite b e1' e2' }>
| RCase b τ e0 e1 e2 e0' e1' e2' L1 L2 :
    e0 ⇛ e0' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <{ e1^x }> ⇛ <{ e1'^x }>) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    lc τ ->
    <{ case inj@b<τ> e0 of e1 | e2 }> ⇛ <{ ite b (e1'^e0') (e2'^e0') }>

| RMux b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ mux [b] e1 e2 }> ⇛ <{ ite b e1' e2' }>
| RSec b :
    <{ s𝔹 b }> ⇛ <{ [b] }>
| ROInj b ω v :
    otval ω -> oval v ->
    <{ ~inj@b<ω> v }> ⇛ <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>

| ROIf b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ ~if [b] then e1 else e2 }> ⇛ <{ ite b e1' e2' }>
| ROCase b ω1 ω2 v v1 v2 e1 e2 e1' e2' L1 L2 :
    oval v ->
    ovalty v1 ω1 -> ovalty v2 ω2 ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <{ e1^x }> ⇛ <{ e1'^x }>) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    <{ ~case [inj@b<ω1 ~+ ω2> v] of e1 | e2 }> ⇛
      <{ ~if [b] then (ite b (e1'^v) (e1'^v1)) else (ite b (e2'^v2) (e2'^v)) }>

| ROIfApp b e1 e2 e e1' e2' e' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ (~if [b] then e1 else e2) e }> ⇛ <{ ~if [b] then e1' e' else e2' e' }>
| ROIfSec b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ s𝔹 (~if [b] then e1 else e2) }> ⇛ <{ ~if [b] then s𝔹 e1' else s𝔹 e2' }>
| ROIfIf b e1 e2 e3 e4 e1' e2' e3' e4' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    e3 ⇛ e3' ->
    e4 ⇛ e4' ->
    <{ if (~if [b] then e1 else e2) then e3 else e4 }> ⇛
      <{ ~if [b] then (if e1' then e3' else e4') else (if e2' then e3' else e4') }>
| ROIfProj b b' e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ π@b' (~if [b] then e1 else e2) }> ⇛
      <{ ~if [b] then π@b' e1' else π@b' e2' }>
| ROIfCase b e1 e2 e3 e4 e1' e2' e3' e4' L1 L2 :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <{ e3^x }> ⇛ <{ e3'^x }>) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <{ e4^x }> ⇛ <{ e4'^x }>) ->
    <{ case (~if [b] then e1 else e2) of e3 | e4 }> ⇛
      <{ ~if [b] then (case e1' of e3' | e4') else (case e2' of e3' | e4') }>
| ROIfUnfold X b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ unfold<X> (~if [b] then e1 else e2) }> ⇛
      <{ ~if [b] then unfold<X> e1' else unfold<X> e2' }>
| RTapeOIf b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ tape (~if [b] then e1 else e2) }> ⇛ <{ mux [b] (tape e1') (tape e2') }>
| RTapePair e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    woval e1 -> woval e2 ->
    <{ tape (e1, e2) }> ⇛ <{ (tape e1', tape e2') }>
| RTapeUnitV :
    <{ tape () }> ⇛ <{ () }>
| RTapeBoxedLit b :
    <{ tape [b] }> ⇛ <{ [b] }>
| RTapeBoxedInj b ω v :
    otval ω -> oval v ->
    <{ tape [inj@b<ω> v] }> ⇛ <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>

| RCgrPi l τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' L :
    τ1 ⇛ τ1' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ τ2^x }> ⇛ <{ τ2'^x }>) ->
    <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }> ⇛ <{ Π:{l}τ1', τ2' }>
| RCgrAbs l τ e τ' e' L :
    τ ⇛ τ' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ e^x }> ⇛ <{ e'^x }>) ->
    <{ \:{l}τ => e }> ⇛ <{ \:{l}τ' => e' }>
| RCgrApp e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ e1 e2 }> ⇛ <{ e1' e2' }>
| RCgrLet e1 e2 e1' e2' L :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    <{ let e1 in e2 }> ⇛ <{ let e1' in e2' }>
| RCgrSec e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ s𝔹 e }> ⇛ <{ s𝔹 e' }>
| RCgrIf l e0 e1 e2 e0' e1' e2' :
    e0 ⇛ e0' ->
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }> ⇛ <{ if{l} e0' then e1' else e2' }>
| RCgrProd τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' :
    τ1 ⇛ τ1' ->
    τ2 ⇛ τ2' ->
    <{ τ1 * τ2 }> ⇛ <{ τ1' * τ2' }>
| RCgrPair e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ (e1, e2) }> ⇛ <{ (e1', e2') }>
| RCgrProj b e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ π@b e }> ⇛ <{ π@b e' }>
| RCgrSum l τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' :
    τ1 ⇛ τ1' ->
    τ2 ⇛ τ2' ->
    <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }> ⇛ <{ τ1' +{l} τ2' }>
| RCgrInj l b τ e τ' e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    τ ⇛ τ' ->
    <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }> ⇛ <{ inj{l}@b<τ'> e' }>
| RCgrCase l e0 e1 e2 e0' e1' e2' L1 L2 :
    e0 ⇛ e0' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <{ e1^x }> ⇛ <{ e1'^x }>) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }> ⇛ <{ case{l} e0' of e1' | e2' }>
| RCgrFold X e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ fold<X> e }> ⇛ <{ fold<X> e' }>
| RCgrUnfold X e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ unfold<X> e }> ⇛ <{ unfold<X> e' }>
| RCgrMux e0 e1 e2 e0' e1' e2' :
    e0 ⇛ e0' ->
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }> ⇛ <{ mux e0' e1' e2' }>
| RCgrTape e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ tape e }> ⇛ <{ tape e' }>

| RRefl e :
    lc e ->
    e ⇛ e

where "e1 '⇛' e2" := (pared e1 e2)
.

Notation "e '⇛*' e'" := (rtc pared e e')
                            (at level 40,
                             e' custom oadt at level 99).

Inductive pared_equiv : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
| QRRefl e : e ≡ e
| QRRedL e1 e1' e2 :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e1' ≡ e2 ->
    e1 ≡ e2
| QRRedR e1 e2 e2' :
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    e1 ≡ e2' ->
    e1 ≡ e2

where "e ≡ e'" := (pared_equiv e e')
.

Definition pared_equiv_join (e1 e2 : expr) : Prop :=
  exists e, e1 ⇛* e /\ e2 ⇛* e.

Reserved Notation "Γ '⊢' e ':{' l '}' τ" (at level 40,
                                          e custom oadt at level 99,
                                          l constr at level 99,
                                          τ custom oadt at level 99).

Reserved Notation "Γ '⊢' τ '::' κ" (at level 40,
                                    τ custom oadt at level 99,
                                    κ custom oadt at level 99).

Inductive typing : tctx -> expr -> bool -> expr -> Prop :=
| TFVar Γ x l τ κ :
    Γ !! x = Some (l, τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ fvar x :{l} τ
| TUnit Γ : Γ ⊢ () :{⊥} 𝟙
| TLit Γ b : Γ ⊢ lit b :{⊥} 𝔹
| TFun Γ x l τ e :
    Σ !! x = Some (DFun (l, τ) e) ->
    Γ ⊢ gvar x :{l} τ
| TAbs Γ l1 l2 e τ1 τ2 κ L :
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(l2, τ2)]>Γ ⊢ e^x :{l1} τ1^x) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ \:{l2}τ2 => e :{l1} (Π:{l2}τ2, τ1)
| TLet Γ l1 l2 l e1 e2 τ1 τ2 L :
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ1 ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(l1, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ e2^x :{l2} τ2^x) ->
    l = l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ let e1 in e2 :{l} τ2^e1
| TApp Γ l1 l2 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} (Π:{l2}τ2, τ1) ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ2 ->
    Γ ⊢ e1 e2 :{l1} τ1^e2
| TPair Γ l1 l2 l e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ1 ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ2 ->
    l = l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ (e1, e2) :{l} τ1 * τ2
| TProj Γ l b e τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ1 * τ2 ->
    Γ ⊢ π@b e :{l} ite b τ1 τ2
| TInj Γ l b e τ1 τ2 κ :
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} ite b τ1 τ2 ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 + τ2 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ inj@b<τ1 + τ2> e :{l} τ1 + τ2
| TIf Γ l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ κ :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} 𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ^(lit true) ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ^(lit false) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ^e0 :: κ ->
    l = l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ if e0 then e1 else e2 :{l} τ^e0
| TIfNoDep Γ l0 l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{l0} 𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ ->
    l = l0 ⊔ l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ if e0 then e1 else e2 :{l} τ
| TCase Γ l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} τ1 + τ2 ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ e1^x :{l1} τ^(inl<τ1 + τ2> x)) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ2)]>Γ ⊢ e2^x :{l2} τ^(inr<τ1 + τ2> x)) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ^e0 :: κ ->
    l = l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ case e0 of e1 | e2 :{l} τ^e0
| TCaseNoDep Γ l0 l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{l0} τ1 + τ2 ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(l0, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ e1^x :{l1} τ) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(l0, τ2)]>Γ ⊢ e2^x :{l2} τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    l = l0 ⊔ l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ case e0 of e1 | e2 :{l} τ
| TFold Γ l X e τ :
    Σ !! X = Some (DADT τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ fold<X> e :{l} gvar X
| TUnfold Γ l X e τ :
    Σ !! X = Some (DADT τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} gvar X ->
    Γ ⊢ unfold<X> e :{l} τ
| TSec Γ l e :
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} 𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ s𝔹 e :{l} ~𝔹
| TMux Γ e0 e1 e2 τ :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} ~𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{⊥} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{⊥} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ mux e0 e1 e2 :{⊥} τ
| TOInj Γ b e τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ e :{⊥} ite b τ1 τ2 ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 ~+ τ2 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ ~inj@b<τ1 ~+ τ2> e :{⊥} τ1 ~+ τ2
| TOIf Γ l1 l2 e0 e1 e2 τ κ :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} ~𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ ~if e0 then e1 else e2 :{⊤} τ
| TOCase Γ l1 l2 e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} τ1 ~+ τ2 ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ e1^x :{l1} τ) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ2)]>Γ ⊢ e2^x :{l2} τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ ~case e0 of e1 | e2 :{⊤} τ
| TTape Γ l e τ :
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ tape e :{⊥} τ

| TBoxedLit Γ b : Γ ⊢ [b] :{⊥} ~𝔹
| TBoxedInj Γ b v ω :
    ovalty <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }> ω ->
    Γ ⊢ [inj@b<ω> v] :{⊥} ω

| TConv Γ l l' e τ τ' κ :
    Γ ⊢ e :{l'} τ' ->
    τ' ≡ τ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    l' ⊑ l ->
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ

with kinding : tctx -> expr -> kind -> Prop :=
| KADT Γ X τ :
    Σ !! X = Some (DADT τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ gvar X :: *@P
| KUnit Γ : Γ ⊢ 𝟙 :: *@A
| KBool Γ l : Γ ⊢ 𝔹{l} :: ite l *@O *@P
| KPi Γ l τ1 τ2 κ1 κ2 L :
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(l, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ τ2^x :: κ2) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: κ1 ->
    Γ ⊢ (Π:{l}τ1, τ2) :: *@M
| KProd Γ τ1 τ2 κ :
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 * τ2 :: κ
| KSum Γ τ1 τ2 κ :
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 + τ2 :: (κ ⊔ *@P)
| KOSum Γ τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 ~+ τ2 :: *@O
| KOADT Γ e' e τ X :
    Σ !! X = Some (DOADT τ e') ->
    Γ ⊢ e :{⊥} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ (gvar X) e :: *@O
| KIf Γ e0 τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} 𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ if e0 then τ1 else τ2 :: *@O
| KCase Γ e0 τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' L1 L2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} τ1' + τ2' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ1')]>Γ ⊢ τ1^x :: *@O) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ2')]>Γ ⊢ τ2^x :: *@O) ->
    Γ ⊢ case e0 of τ1 | τ2 :: *@O
| KLet Γ e τ τ' L :
    Γ ⊢ e :{⊥} τ' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(⊥, τ')]>Γ ⊢ τ^x :: *@O) ->
    Γ ⊢ let e in τ :: *@O
| KSub Γ τ κ κ' :
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ' ->
    κ' ⊑ κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ

where "Γ '⊢' e ':{' l '}' τ" := (typing Γ e l τ)
  and "Γ '⊢' τ '::' κ" := (kinding Γ τ κ)
.

End fix_gctx.

Scheme typing_kinding_ind := Minimality for typing Sort Prop
  with kinding_typing_ind := Minimality for kinding Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme typing_kinding_mutind
         from typing_kinding_ind, kinding_typing_ind.

Notation "Σ '⊢' e '≡' e'" := (pared_equiv Σ e e')
                               (at level 40,
                                e custom oadt at level 99,
                                e' custom oadt at level 99).

Notation "Σ ; Γ '⊢' e ':{' l '}' τ" := (typing Σ Γ e l τ)
                                         (at level 40,
                                          Γ constr at level 0,
                                          e custom oadt at level 99,
                                          τ custom oadt at level 99,
                                          format "Σ ;  Γ  '⊢'  e  ':{' l '}'  τ").

Notation "Σ ; Γ '⊢' τ '::' κ" := (kinding Σ Γ τ κ)
                                   (at level 40,
                                    Γ constr at level 0,
                                    τ custom oadt at level 99,
                                    κ custom oadt at level 99).

Reserved Notation "Σ '⊢₁' D" (at level 40,
                               D constr at level 0).

Inductive gdef_typing : gctx -> gdef -> Prop :=
| DTADT Σ τ :
    Σ; ∅ ⊢ τ :: *@P ->
    Σ ⊢₁ (DADT τ)
| DTOADT Σ τ e L :
    Σ; ∅ ⊢ τ :: *@P ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> Σ; ({[x:=(⊥, τ)]}) ⊢ e^x :: *@O) ->
    Σ ⊢₁ (DOADT τ e)
| DTFun Σ l τ e κ :
    Σ; ∅ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    Σ; ∅ ⊢ e :{l} τ ->
    Σ ⊢₁ (DFun (l, τ) e)

where "Σ '⊢₁' D" := (gdef_typing Σ D)
.

Definition gctx_typing (Σ : gctx) : Prop :=
  map_Forall (fun _ D => Σ ⊢₁ D) Σ.

Definition program_typing (Σ : gctx) (e : expr) (τ : expr) :=
  gctx_typing Σ /\ Σ; ∅ ⊢ e :{⊥} τ.

End typing.

352	    <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }> ≈ <{ Π:{l}τ1', τ2' }>
353	| IAbs l τ τ' e e' :
354	    τ ≈ τ' ->
355	    e ≈ e' ->
356	    <{ \:{l}τ => e }> ≈ <{ \:{l}τ' => e' }>
357	| IApp e1 e1' e2 e2' :
358	    e1 ≈ e1' ->
359	    e2 ≈ e2' ->
360	    <{ e1 e2 }> ≈ <{ e1' e2' }>
361	| ILet e1 e1' e2 e2' :
362	    e1 ≈ e1' ->
363	    e2 ≈ e2' ->
364	    <{ let e1 in e2 }> ≈ <{ let e1' in e2' }>
365	| IUnitT : <{ 𝟙 }> ≈ <{ 𝟙 }>
366	| IUnitV : <{ () }> ≈ <{ () }>
367	| IBool l : <{ 𝔹{l} }> ≈ <{ 𝔹{l} }>
368	| ILit b : <{ lit b }> ≈ <{ lit b }>
369	| ISec e e' :
370	    e ≈ e' ->
371	    <{ s𝔹 e }> ≈ <{ s𝔹 e' }>
372	| IIte l e0 e0' e1 e1' e2 e2' :
373	    e0 ≈ e0' ->
374	    e1 ≈ e1' ->
375	    e2 ≈ e2' ->
376	    <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }> ≈ <{ if{l} e0' then e1' else e2' }>
377	| IProd τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :
378	    τ1 ≈ τ1' ->
379	    τ2 ≈ τ2' ->
380	    <{ τ1 * τ2 }> ≈ <{ τ1' * τ2' }>
381	| IPair e1 e1' e2 e2' :
382	    e1 ≈ e1' ->
383	    e2 ≈ e2' ->
384	    <{ (e1, e2) }> ≈ <{ (e1', e2') }>
385	| IProj b e e' :
386	    e ≈ e' ->
387	    <{ π@b e }> ≈ <{ π@b e' }>
388	| ISum l τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :
389	    τ1 ≈ τ1' ->
390	    τ2 ≈ τ2' ->
391	    <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }> ≈ <{ τ1' +{l} τ2' }>
392	| IInj l b τ τ' e e' :
393	    τ ≈ τ' ->
394	    e ≈ e' ->
395	    <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }> ≈ <{ inj{l}@b<τ'> e' }>
396	| ICase l e0 e0' e1 e1' e2 e2' :
397	    e0 ≈ e0' ->
398	    e1 ≈ e1' ->
399	    e2 ≈ e2' ->
400	    <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }> ≈ <{ case{l} e0' of e1' | e2' }>
401	| IFold X e e' :
402	    e ≈ e' ->
403	    <{ fold<X> e }> ≈ <{ fold<X> e' }>
404	| IUnfold X e e' :
405	    e ≈ e' ->
406	    <{ unfold<X> e }> ≈ <{ unfold<X> e' }>
407	| ITape e e' :
408	    e ≈ e' ->
409	    <{ tape e }> ≈ <{ tape e' }>
410	| IMux e0 e0' e1 e1' e2 e2' :
411	    e0 ≈ e0' ->
412	    e1 ≈ e1' ->
413	    e2 ≈ e2' ->
414	    <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }> ≈ <{ mux e0' e1' e2' }>
415	
416	| IBoxedLit b b' :
417	
418	    <{ [b] }> ≈ <{ [b'] }>
419	| IBoxedInj b b' τ e e' :
420	
421	    <{ [inj@b<τ> e] }> ≈ <{ [inj@b'<τ> e'] }>
422	
423	where "e '≈' e'" := (indistinguishable e e').
424	
425	Reserved Notation "'{' k '~>' s '}' e" (in custom oadt at level 20, k constr).
426	
427	Fixpoint open_ (k : nat) (s : expr) (e : expr) : expr :=
428	  match e with
429	  | <{ bvar n }> => if decide (k = n) then s else e
430	  | <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }> => <{ Π:{l}({k~>s}τ1), {S k~>s}τ2 }>
431	  | <{ \:{l}τ => e }> => <{ \:{l}({k~>s}τ) => {S k~>s}e }>
432	  | <{ let e1 in e2 }> => <{ let {k~>s}e1 in {S k~>s}e2 }>
433	  | <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }> => <{ case{l} {k~>s}e0 of {S k~>s}e1 | {S k~>s}e2 }>
434	
435	  | <{ e1 e2 }> => <{ ({k~>s}e1) ({k~>s}e2) }>
436	  | <{ s𝔹 e }> => <{ s𝔹 ({k~>s}e) }>
437	  | <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }> => <{ if{l} {k~>s}e0 then {k~>s}e1 else {k~>s}e2 }>
438	  | <{ τ1 * τ2 }> => <{ ({k~>s}τ1) * ({k~>s}τ2) }>
439	  | <{ (e1, e2) }> => <{ ({k~>s}e1, {k~>s}e2) }>
440	  | <{ π@b e }> => <{ π@b ({k~>s}e) }>
441	  | <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }> => <{ ({k~>s}τ1) +{l} ({k~>s}τ2) }>
442	  | <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }> => <{ inj{l}@b<({k~>s}τ)> ({k~>s}e) }>
443	  | <{ fold<X> e }> => <{ fold<X> ({k~>s}e) }>
444	  | <{ unfold<X> e }> => <{ unfold<X> ({k~>s}e) }>
445	  | <{ tape e }> => <{ tape ({k~>s}e) }>
446	  | <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }> => <{ mux ({k~>s}e0) ({k~>s}e1) ({k~>s}e2) }>
447	  | _ => e
448	  end
449	
450	where "'{' k '~>' s '}' e" := (open_ k s e) (in custom oadt).
451	
452	Definition open s e := open_ 0 s e.
453	
454	Notation "e ^ s" := (open s e) (in custom oadt at level 20).
455	
456	Reserved Notation "'{' x '↦' s '}' e" (in custom oadt at level 20, x constr).
457	
458	Fixpoint subst (x : atom) (s : expr) (e : expr) : expr :=
459	  match e with
460	  | <{ fvar y }> => if decide (x = y) then s else e
461	
462	  | <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }> => <{ Π:{l}({x↦s}τ1), {x↦s}τ2 }>
463	  | <{ \:{l}τ => e }> => <{ \:{l}({x↦s}τ) => {x↦s}e }>
464	  | <{ e1 e2 }> => <{ ({x↦s}e1) ({x↦s}e2) }>
465	  | <{ let e1 in e2 }> => <{ let {x↦s}e1 in {x↦s}e2 }>
466	  | <{ s𝔹 e }> => <{ s𝔹 ({x↦s}e) }>
467	  | <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }> => <{ if{l} {x↦s}e0 then {x↦s}e1 else {x↦s}e2 }>
468	  | <{ τ1 * τ2 }> => <{ ({x↦s}τ1) * ({x↦s}τ2) }>
469	  | <{ (e1, e2) }> => <{ ({x↦s}e1, {x↦s}e2) }>
470	  | <{ π@b e }> => <{ π@b ({x↦s}e) }>
471	  | <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }> => <{ ({x↦s}τ1) +{l} ({x↦s}τ2) }>
472	  | <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }> => <{ inj{l}@b<({x↦s}τ)> ({x↦s}e) }>
473	  | <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }> => <{ case{l} {x↦s}e0 of {x↦s}e1 | {x↦s}e2 }>
474	  | <{ fold<X> e }> => <{ fold<X> ({x↦s}e) }>
475	  | <{ unfold<X> e }> => <{ unfold<X> ({x↦s}e) }>
476	  | <{ tape e }> => <{ tape ({x↦s}e) }>
477	  | <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }> => <{ mux ({x↦s}e0) ({x↦s}e1) ({x↦s}e2) }>
478	  | _ => e
479	  end
480	
481	where "'{' x '↦' s '}' e" := (subst x s e) (in custom oadt).
482	
483	Definition lexpr_subst x s (T : lexpr) := (T.1, subst x s T.2).
484	
485	Inductive otval : expr -> Prop :=
486	| OVUnitT : otval <{ 𝟙 }>
487	| OVOBool : otval <{ ~𝔹 }>
488	| OVProd ω1 ω2 : otval ω1 -> otval ω2 -> otval <{ ω1 * ω2 }>
489	| OVOSum ω1 ω2 : otval ω1 -> otval ω2 -> otval <{ ω1 ~+ ω2 }>
490	.
491	
492	Inductive oval : expr -> Prop :=
493	| OVUnitV : oval <{ () }>
494	| OVBoxedLit b : oval <{ [b] }>
495	| OVPair v1 v2 : oval v1 -> oval v2 -> oval <{ (v1, v2) }>
496	| OVBoxedInj b ω v : otval ω -> oval v -> oval <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>
497	.
498	
499	Inductive val : expr -> Prop :=
500	| VUnitV : val <{ () }>
501	| VLit b : val <{ lit b }>
502	| VPair v1 v2 : val v1 -> val v2 -> val <{ (v1, v2) }>
503	| VAbs l τ e : val <{ \:{l}τ => e }>
504	| VInj b τ v : val v -> val <{ inj@b<τ> v }>
505	| VFold X v : val v -> val <{ fold<X> v }>
506	| VBoxedLit b : val <{ [b] }>
507	| VBoxedInj b ω v : otval ω -> oval v -> val <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>
508	.
509	
510	Inductive lc : expr -> Prop :=
511	| LCFVar x : lc <{ fvar x }>
512	| LCGVar x : lc <{ gvar x }>
513	| LCPi l τ1 τ2 L :
514	    (forall x, x ∉ L -> lc <{ τ2^x }>) ->
515	    lc τ1 -> lc <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }>
516	| LCAbs l τ e L :
517	    (forall x, x ∉ L -> lc <{ e^x }>) ->
518	    lc τ -> lc <{ \:{l}τ => e }>
519	| LCLet e1 e2 L :
520	    (forall x, x ∉ L -> lc <{ e2^x }>) ->
521	    lc e1 -> lc <{ let e1 in e2 }>
522	| LCCase l e0 e1 e2 L1 L2 :
523	    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> lc <{ e1^x }>) ->
524	    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> lc <{ e2^x }>) ->
525	    lc e0 -> lc <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }>
526	
527	| LCUnitT : lc <{ 𝟙 }>
528	| LCUnitV : lc <{ () }>
529	| LCBool l : lc <{ 𝔹{l} }>
530	| LCApp e1 e2 : lc e1 -> lc e2 -> lc <{ e1 e2 }>
531	| LCLit b : lc <{ lit b }>
532	| LCSec e : lc e -> lc <{ s𝔹 e }>
533	| LCIte l e0 e1 e2 : lc e0 -> lc e1 -> lc e2 -> lc <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }>
534	| LCProd τ1 τ2 : lc τ1 -> lc τ2 -> lc <{ τ1 * τ2 }>
535	| LCPair e1 e2 : lc e1 -> lc e2 -> lc <{ (e1, e2) }>
536	| LCProj b e : lc e -> lc <{ π@b e }>
537	| LCSum l τ1 τ2 : lc τ1 -> lc τ2 -> lc <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }>
538	| LCInj l b τ e : lc τ -> lc e -> lc <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }>
539	| LCFold X e : lc e -> lc <{ fold<X> e }>
540	| LCUnfold X e : lc e -> lc <{ unfold<X> e }>
541	| LCTape e : lc e -> lc <{ tape e }>
542	| LCMux e0 e1 e2 : lc e0 -> lc e1 -> lc e2 -> lc <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }>
543	| LCBoxedLit b : lc <{ [b] }>
544	
545	| LCBoxedInj b ω v : otval ω -> oval v -> lc <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>
546	.
547	
548	End definitions.
549	
550	Module notations.
551	
552	Export expr_notations.
553	
554	Notation "e '≈' e'" := (indistinguishable e e') (at level 40).
555	
556	Notation "'{' k '~>' s '}' e" := (open_ k s e)
557	                                   (in custom oadt at level 20, k constr).
558	
559	Notation "e ^ s" := (open s e) (in custom oadt at level 20).
560	
561	Notation "'{' x '↦' s '}' e" := (subst x s e)
562	                                  (in custom oadt at level 20, x constr).
563	
564	Notation "{ x '↦' s }" := (lexpr_subst x s) (at level 20).
565	
566	End notations.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.base.

Implicit Types (b : bool) (x X y Y : atom) (L : aset).

Open Scope type_scope.

Notation olabel := bool (only parsing).

Notation LObliv := true (only parsing).

Notation LPub := false (only parsing).

Notation llabel := bool (only parsing).

Notation LLeak := true (only parsing).

Notation LSafe := false (only parsing).

Inductive expr :=

| EBVar (k : nat)

| EFVar (x : atom)

| EGVar (x : atom)

| EUnitT

| EBool (l : olabel)
| EProd (τ1 τ2 : expr)

| ESum (l : olabel) (τ1 τ2 : expr)

| EPi (l : llabel) (τ1 τ2: expr)

| EUnitV
| ELit (b : bool)

| EAbs (l : llabel) (τ e : expr)

| EApp (e1 e2 : expr)

| ELet (e1 e2 : expr)

| EIte (l : olabel) (e0 e1 e2 : expr)

| EPair (e1 e2 : expr)
| EProj (b : bool) (e : expr)

| EInj (l : olabel) (b : bool) (τ e : expr)

| ECase (l : olabel) (e0 : expr) (e1 : expr) (e2 : expr)

| EFold (X : atom) (e : expr)
| EUnfold (X : atom) (e : expr)

| ESec (e : expr)

| ETape (e : expr)

| EMux (e0 e1 e2 : expr)

| EBoxedLit (b : bool)
| EBoxedInj (b : bool) (τ e : expr)
.

Definition lexpr := (llabel * expr).

Definition lexpr_label : lexpr -> llabel := fst.

Arguments lexpr_label /.

Definition lexpr_expr : lexpr -> expr := snd.

Arguments lexpr_expr /.

Variant gdef :=
| DADT (e : expr)
| DFun (T : lexpr) (e : expr)
| DOADT (τ e : expr)
.

Notation gctx := (amap gdef).

Notation program := (gctx * expr).

Module expr_notations.

Coercion ELit : bool >-> expr.

Coercion lexpr_expr : lexpr >-> expr.

Notation "<{ e }>" := e (e custom oadt at level 99).

Notation "',(' e ')'" := e (in custom oadt at level 0,
                               e constr at level 0).

Notation "( x )" := x (in custom oadt, x at level 99).

Notation "x" := x (in custom oadt at level 0, x constr at level 0).

Notation "'bvar' x" := (EBVar x) (in custom oadt at level 0, x constr at level 0).

Notation "'fvar' x" := (EFVar x) (in custom oadt at level 0, x constr at level 0,
                                     only parsing).

Notation "'gvar' x" := (EGVar x) (in custom oadt at level 0, x constr at level 0).

Notation "'lit' b" := (ELit b) (in custom oadt at level 0, b constr at level 0,
                                   only parsing).

Notation "'𝟙'" := EUnitT (in custom oadt at level 0).

Notation "'Unit'" := EUnitT (in custom oadt at level 0, only parsing).

Notation "'𝔹{' l '}'" := (EBool l) (in custom oadt at level 0,
                                       l constr at level 0,
                                       format "'𝔹{' l '}'").

Notation "'𝔹'" := (EBool LPub) (in custom oadt at level 0).

Notation "'Bool'" := (EBool LPub) (in custom oadt at level 0, only parsing).

Notation "'~𝔹'" := (EBool LObliv) (in custom oadt at level 0).

Notation "'~Bool'" := (EBool LObliv) (in custom oadt at level 0, only parsing).

Notation "τ1 * τ2" := (EProd τ1 τ2) (in custom oadt at level 3,
                                        τ1 custom oadt,
                                        τ2 custom oadt at level 0).

Notation "τ1 '+{' l '}' τ2" := (ESum l τ1 τ2) (in custom oadt at level 4,
                                                  l constr at level 0,
                                                  left associativity,
                                                  format "τ1  '+{' l '}'  τ2").

Notation "τ1 + τ2" := (ESum LPub τ1 τ2) (in custom oadt at level 4,
                                            left associativity).

Notation "τ1 ~+ τ2" := (ESum LObliv τ1 τ2) (in custom oadt at level 4,
                                               left associativity).

Notation "'Π' :{ l } τ1 , τ2" := (EPi l τ1 τ2)
                                   (in custom oadt at level 50,
                                       right associativity,
                                       format "Π :{ l } τ1 ,  τ2").

Notation "'Π' : τ1 , τ2" := (EPi LSafe τ1 τ2)
                              (in custom oadt at level 50,
                                  right associativity,
                                  format "Π : τ1 ,  τ2").

Notation "'Π' ~: τ1 , τ2" := (EPi LLeak τ1 τ2)
                               (in custom oadt at level 50,
                                   right associativity,
                                   format "Π ~: τ1 ,  τ2").

Notation "\ :{ l } τ '=>' e" := (EAbs l τ e)
                                  (in custom oadt at level 90,
                                      τ custom oadt at level 99,
                                      e custom oadt at level 99,
                                      left associativity,
                                      format "\ :{ l } τ  =>  e").

Notation "\ : τ '=>' e" := (EAbs LSafe τ e)
                             (in custom oadt at level 90,
                                 τ custom oadt at level 99,
                                 e custom oadt at level 99,
                                 left associativity,
                                 format "\ : τ  =>  e").

Notation "\ ~: τ '=>' e" := (EAbs LLeak τ e)
                              (in custom oadt at level 90,
                                  τ custom oadt at level 99,
                                  e custom oadt at level 99,
                                  left associativity,
                                  format "\ ~: τ  =>  e").

Notation "e1 e2" := (EApp e1 e2) (in custom oadt at level 2, left associativity).

Notation "()" := EUnitV (in custom oadt at level 0).

Notation "( x , y , .. , z )" := (EPair .. (EPair x y) .. z)
                                   (in custom oadt at level 0,
                                       x custom oadt at level 99,
                                       y custom oadt at level 99,
                                       z custom oadt at level 99).

Notation "'π@' b e" := (EProj b e) (in custom oadt at level 2,
                                       b constr at level 0,
                                       format "π@ b  e").

Notation "'π1' e" := (EProj true e) (in custom oadt at level 2).

Notation "'π2' e" := (EProj false e) (in custom oadt at level 2).

Notation "'s𝔹' e" := (ESec e) (in custom oadt at level 2).

Notation "'if{' l '}' e0 'then' e1 'else' e2" := (EIte l e0 e1 e2)
                                                   (in custom oadt at level 89,
                                                       l constr at level 0,
                                                       e0 custom oadt at level 99,
                                                       e1 custom oadt at level 99,
                                                       e2 custom oadt at level 99,
                                                       left associativity,
                                                       format "'if{' l '}'  e0  'then'  e1  'else'  e2").

Notation "'if' e0 'then' e1 'else' e2" := (EIte LPub e0 e1 e2)
                                            (in custom oadt at level 89,
                                                e0 custom oadt at level 99,
                                                e1 custom oadt at level 99,
                                                e2 custom oadt at level 99,
                                                left associativity).

Notation "'~if' e0 'then' e1 'else' e2" := (EIte LObliv e0 e1 e2)
                                             (in custom oadt at level 89,
                                                 e0 custom oadt at level 99,
                                                 e1 custom oadt at level 99,
                                                 e2 custom oadt at level 99).

Notation "'let' e1 'in' e2" := (ELet e1 e2)
                                 (in custom oadt at level 0,
                                     e1 custom oadt at level 99,
                                     e2 custom oadt at level 99).

Notation "'inj{' l '}@' b < τ > e" := (EInj l b τ e) (in custom oadt at level 2,
                                                         l constr at level 0,
                                                         b constr at level 0,
                                                         τ custom oadt at level 0,
                                                         format "'inj{' l '}@' b < τ >  e").

Notation "'inl{' l '}' < τ > e" := (EInj l true τ e) (in custom oadt at level 2,
                                                         τ custom oadt at level 0,
                                                         format "inl{ l } < τ >  e").

Notation "'inr{' l '}' < τ > e" := (EInj l false τ e) (in custom oadt at level 2,
                                                          τ custom oadt at level 0,
                                                          format "inr{ l } < τ >  e").

Notation "'inj@' b < τ > e" := (EInj LPub b τ e) (in custom oadt at level 2,
                                                     b constr at level 0,
                                                     τ custom oadt at level 0,
                                                     format "inj@ b < τ >  e").

Notation "'inl' < τ > e" := (EInj LPub true τ e) (in custom oadt at level 2,
                                                     τ custom oadt at level 0,
                                                     format "inl < τ >  e").

Notation "'inr' < τ > e" := (EInj LPub false τ e) (in custom oadt at level 2,
                                                      τ custom oadt at level 0,
                                                      format "inr < τ >  e").

Notation "'~inj@' b < τ > e" := (EInj LObliv b τ e) (in custom oadt at level 2,
                                                        b constr at level 0,
                                                        τ custom oadt at level 0,
                                                        format "~inj@ b < τ >  e").

Notation "'~inl' < τ > e" := (EInj LObliv true τ e) (in custom oadt at level 2,
                                                        τ custom oadt at level 0,
                                                        format "~inl < τ >  e").

Notation "'~inr' < τ > e" := (EInj LObliv false τ e) (in custom oadt at level 2,
                                                         τ custom oadt at level 0,
                                                         format "~inr < τ >  e").

Notation "'case{' l '}' e0 'of' e1 '|' e2" :=
  (ECase l e0 e1 e2) (in custom oadt at level 89,
                         l constr at level 0,
                         e0 custom oadt at level 99,
                         e1 custom oadt at level 99,
                         e2 custom oadt at level 99,
                         left associativity,
                         format "'case{' l '}'  e0  'of'  e1  '|'  e2").

Notation "'case' e0 'of' e1 '|' e2" :=
  (ECase LPub e0 e1 e2) (in custom oadt at level 89,
                            e0 custom oadt at level 99,
                            e1 custom oadt at level 99,
                            e2 custom oadt at level 99,
                            left associativity).

Notation "'~case' e0 'of' e1 '|' e2" :=
  (ECase LObliv e0 e1 e2) (in custom oadt at level 89,
                              e0 custom oadt at level 99,
                              e1 custom oadt at level 99,
                              e2 custom oadt at level 99,
                              left associativity).

Notation "'fold' < X > e" := (EFold X e) (in custom oadt at level 2,
                                             X custom oadt at level 0,
                                             format "fold < X >  e").

Notation "'unfold' < X > e" := (EUnfold X e) (in custom oadt at level 2,
                                                 X custom oadt at level 0,

Coercion EFVar : atom >-> expr.

Reserved Notation "e '≈' e'" (at level 40).

Inductive indistinguishable : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
| IBVar k : <{ bvar k }> ≈ <{ bvar k }>
| IFVar x : <{ fvar x }> ≈ <{ fvar x }>
| IGVar x : <{ gvar x }> ≈ <{ gvar x }>
| IPi l τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :
    τ1 ≈ τ1' ->
    τ2 ≈ τ2' ->
    <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }> ≈ <{ Π:{l}τ1', τ2' }>
| IAbs l τ τ' e e' :
    τ ≈ τ' ->
    e ≈ e' ->
    <{ \:{l}τ => e }> ≈ <{ \:{l}τ' => e' }>
| IApp e1 e1' e2 e2' :
    e1 ≈ e1' ->
    e2 ≈ e2' ->
    <{ e1 e2 }> ≈ <{ e1' e2' }>
| ILet e1 e1' e2 e2' :
    e1 ≈ e1' ->
    e2 ≈ e2' ->
    <{ let e1 in e2 }> ≈ <{ let e1' in e2' }>
| IUnitT : <{ 𝟙 }> ≈ <{ 𝟙 }>
| IUnitV : <{ () }> ≈ <{ () }>
| IBool l : <{ 𝔹{l} }> ≈ <{ 𝔹{l} }>
| ILit b : <{ lit b }> ≈ <{ lit b }>
| ISec e e' :
    e ≈ e' ->
    <{ s𝔹 e }> ≈ <{ s𝔹 e' }>
| IIte l e0 e0' e1 e1' e2 e2' :
    e0 ≈ e0' ->
    e1 ≈ e1' ->
    e2 ≈ e2' ->
    <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }> ≈ <{ if{l} e0' then e1' else e2' }>
| IProd τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :
    τ1 ≈ τ1' ->
    τ2 ≈ τ2' ->
    <{ τ1 * τ2 }> ≈ <{ τ1' * τ2' }>
| IPair e1 e1' e2 e2' :
    e1 ≈ e1' ->
    e2 ≈ e2' ->
    <{ (e1, e2) }> ≈ <{ (e1', e2') }>
| IProj b e e' :
    e ≈ e' ->
    <{ π@b e }> ≈ <{ π@b e' }>
| ISum l τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :
    τ1 ≈ τ1' ->
    τ2 ≈ τ2' ->
    <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }> ≈ <{ τ1' +{l} τ2' }>
| IInj l b τ τ' e e' :
    τ ≈ τ' ->
    e ≈ e' ->
    <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }> ≈ <{ inj{l}@b<τ'> e' }>
| ICase l e0 e0' e1 e1' e2 e2' :
    e0 ≈ e0' ->
    e1 ≈ e1' ->
    e2 ≈ e2' ->
    <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }> ≈ <{ case{l} e0' of e1' | e2' }>
| IFold X e e' :
    e ≈ e' ->
    <{ fold<X> e }> ≈ <{ fold<X> e' }>
| IUnfold X e e' :
    e ≈ e' ->
    <{ unfold<X> e }> ≈ <{ unfold<X> e' }>
| ITape e e' :
    e ≈ e' ->
    <{ tape e }> ≈ <{ tape e' }>
| IMux e0 e0' e1 e1' e2 e2' :
    e0 ≈ e0' ->
    e1 ≈ e1' ->
    e2 ≈ e2' ->
    <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }> ≈ <{ mux e0' e1' e2' }>

| IBoxedLit b b' :

    <{ [b] }> ≈ <{ [b'] }>
| IBoxedInj b b' τ e e' :

    <{ [inj@b<τ> e] }> ≈ <{ [inj@b'<τ> e'] }>

where "e '≈' e'" := (indistinguishable e e').

Reserved Notation "'{' k '~>' s '}' e" (in custom oadt at level 20, k constr).

Fixpoint open_ (k : nat) (s : expr) (e : expr) : expr :=
  match e with
  | <{ bvar n }> => if decide (k = n) then s else e
  | <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }> => <{ Π:{l}({k~>s}τ1), {S k~>s}τ2 }>
  | <{ \:{l}τ => e }> => <{ \:{l}({k~>s}τ) => {S k~>s}e }>
  | <{ let e1 in e2 }> => <{ let {k~>s}e1 in {S k~>s}e2 }>
  | <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }> => <{ case{l} {k~>s}e0 of {S k~>s}e1 | {S k~>s}e2 }>

  | <{ s𝔹 e }> => <{ s𝔹 ({k~>s}e) }>
  | <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }> => <{ if{l} {k~>s}e0 then {k~>s}e1 else {k~>s}e2 }>

  | <{ π@b e }> => <{ π@b ({k~>s}e) }>
  | <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }> => <{ ({k~>s}τ1) +{l} ({k~>s}τ2) }>
  | <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }> => <{ inj{l}@b<({k~>s}τ)> ({k~>s}e) }>
  | <{ fold<X> e }> => <{ fold<X> ({k~>s}e) }>
  | <{ unfold<X> e }> => <{ unfold<X> ({k~>s}e) }>
  | <{ tape e }> => <{ tape ({k~>s}e) }>
  | <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }> => <{ mux ({k~>s}e0) ({k~>s}e1) ({k~>s}e2) }>

  end

where "'{' k '~>' s '}' e" := (open_ k s e) (in custom oadt).

Notation "e ^ s" := (open s e) (in custom oadt at level 20).

Reserved Notation "'{' x '↦' s '}' e" (in custom oadt at level 20, x constr).

Fixpoint subst (x : atom) (s : expr) (e : expr) : expr :=
  match e with
  | <{ fvar y }> => if decide (x = y) then s else e

  | <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }> => <{ Π:{l}({x↦s}τ1), {x↦s}τ2 }>
  | <{ \:{l}τ => e }> => <{ \:{l}({x↦s}τ) => {x↦s}e }>
  | <{ e1 e2 }> => <{ ({x↦s}e1) ({x↦s}e2) }>
  | <{ let e1 in e2 }> => <{ let {x↦s}e1 in {x↦s}e2 }>
  | <{ s𝔹 e }> => <{ s𝔹 ({x↦s}e) }>
  | <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }> => <{ if{l} {x↦s}e0 then {x↦s}e1 else {x↦s}e2 }>
  | <{ τ1 * τ2 }> => <{ ({x↦s}τ1) * ({x↦s}τ2) }>
  | <{ (e1, e2) }> => <{ ({x↦s}e1, {x↦s}e2) }>
  | <{ π@b e }> => <{ π@b ({x↦s}e) }>
  | <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }> => <{ ({x↦s}τ1) +{l} ({x↦s}τ2) }>
  | <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }> => <{ inj{l}@b<({x↦s}τ)> ({x↦s}e) }>
  | <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }> => <{ case{l} {x↦s}e0 of {x↦s}e1 | {x↦s}e2 }>
  | <{ fold<X> e }> => <{ fold<X> ({x↦s}e) }>
  | <{ unfold<X> e }> => <{ unfold<X> ({x↦s}e) }>
  | <{ tape e }> => <{ tape ({x↦s}e) }>
  | <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }> => <{ mux ({x↦s}e0) ({x↦s}e1) ({x↦s}e2) }>

  end

| OVOBool : otval <{ ~𝔹 }>

| OVBoxedLit b : oval <{ [b] }>
| OVPair v1 v2 : oval v1 -> oval v2 -> oval <{ (v1, v2) }>

.

| VLit b : val <{ lit b }>
| VPair v1 v2 : val v1 -> val v2 -> val <{ (v1, v2) }>
| VAbs l τ e : val <{ \:{l}τ => e }>
| VInj b τ v : val v -> val <{ inj@b<τ> v }>
| VFold X v : val v -> val <{ fold<X> v }>

.

| LCCase l e0 e1 e2 L1 L2 :
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> lc <{ e1^x }>) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> lc <{ e2^x }>) ->
    lc e0 -> lc <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }>

| LCUnitT : lc <{ 𝟙 }>
| LCUnitV : lc <{ () }>
| LCBool l : lc <{ 𝔹{l} }>
| LCApp e1 e2 : lc e1 -> lc e2 -> lc <{ e1 e2 }>
| LCLit b : lc <{ lit b }>
| LCSec e : lc e -> lc <{ s𝔹 e }>
| LCIte l e0 e1 e2 : lc e0 -> lc e1 -> lc e2 -> lc <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }>
| LCProd τ1 τ2 : lc τ1 -> lc τ2 -> lc <{ τ1 * τ2 }>
| LCPair e1 e2 : lc e1 -> lc e2 -> lc <{ (e1, e2) }>
| LCProj b e : lc e -> lc <{ π@b e }>
| LCSum l τ1 τ2 : lc τ1 -> lc τ2 -> lc <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }>
| LCInj l b τ e : lc τ -> lc e -> lc <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }>
| LCFold X e : lc e -> lc <{ fold<X> e }>
| LCUnfold X e : lc e -> lc <{ unfold<X> e }>
| LCTape e : lc e -> lc <{ tape e }>
| LCMux e0 e1 e2 : lc e0 -> lc e1 -> lc e2 -> lc <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }>
| LCBoxedLit b : lc <{ [b] }>

| LCBoxedInj b ω v : otval ω -> oval v -> lc <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>
.

The task: prove trace obliviousness. Given two programs e1, e2 with program typing (gctx_typing Σ and empty-context typing at ⊥) and e1 ≈ e2, show trace_indistinguishable.

This is a hard theorem. Let's think about what's needed. Actually wait. Hmm, is this provable at all from the given hypotheses? `e1 ≈ e2` is syntactic indistinguishability (a structural relation where boxed literals can differ: IBoxedLit b b' allows differing b's, and IBoxedInj b b' τ e e' allows differing b's, and possibly e ≈ e' but τ need not be equal! Look: IBoxedInj b b' τ e e' : [inj@b<τ> e] ≈ [inj@b'<τ> e'] with same τ but arbitrary b, b'. So the equivalence is: terms equal up to the values inside boxes (secrets).

Given e1 ≈ e2 and both well typed, show that for any n and any e1' such that e1 steps n times to e1', there is e2' with e2 steps n times to e2', and any such e2' is ≈ e1'.

Hmm, this looks extremely hard in general: strong normalization is needed? Actually nsteps means exactly n steps. If e1 can step n times, e2 must be able to step n times too, and results match up to ≈. Since both are well typed programs, progress and determinism... Hmm but e1≈e2 doesn't imply e1 and e2 reduce in lockstep structurally. Wait, but maybe it does, because the only differences are inside boxed literals and boxed injections, and... Hmm, but a public branch on a boxed literal? Public `if` requires the condition typed at ⊥ level 𝔹, not ~𝔹. Boxed literals have type ~𝔹, so you can't branch on them publicly. But could e1 and e2 differ in boxed literal b vs b' and still step differently at the top level? The semantics: `s𝔹 b` → [b]. `mux [b] v1 v2` → ite b v1 v2. `~if [b] then v1 else v2` → ... So the semantics never branches on the boxed literal b in a way that produces different expression structure except under the box or in oblivious contexts. Actually with `mux [b] v1 v2` → ite b v1 v2, the result differs depending on b! But `mux` at level ⊥ requires... TMux requires e0 :{⊥} ~𝔹, e1,e2 :{⊥} τ, τ :: *@O. And the outputs v1, v2 could differ in their box contents, so ite b v1 v2 would be either v1 or v2, but v1 ≈ v2? Not necessarily — v1 and v2 both have type τ but could differ arbitrary structurally? Hmm, e ≈ e' relates two syntactically different expressions with possibly different shapes? Let's check the constructors: every constructor requires the same shape on both sides except IBoxedLit, IBoxedInj. So ≈ implies structural equality modulo box contents (and within boxed injections the whole inner expression can differ... no wait IBoxedInj takes e and e' arbitrary? Look: `IBoxedInj b b' τ e e' : <{ [inj@b<τ> e] }> ≈ <{ [inj@b'<τ> e'] }>` — no premise on e ≈ e'! So e, e' arbitrary. Interesting. Similarly IBoxedLit b b' arbitrary b,b'.

So ≈ is: same syntactic structure except boxed literals can have any bools, and boxed injections can have any bool and any inner expression. So e1 and e2 differ only inside boxes (which never get opened) — the "payload" of the boxes is secret.

But `mux [b] v1 v2` reduces to `ite b v1 v2` which is a *structural* choice depending on b! If e1 has b=true and e2 has b=false, then e1' = v1 and e2' = v2. Then e1' ≈ e2' — but v1 and v2 need not be ≈! Hmm, but wait, in `mux`, the mux is at level ⊥ (public). TMux says the result has type τ::*@O (oblivious type). The two branches v1, v2 are typed at ⊥ with type τ which is oblivious. But two different values of the same oblivious type need not be ≈ (e.g., τ = 𝟙~+ ... hmm, an oblivious type's values differ only in box contents? Not necessarily: τ = 𝔹? No, 𝔹 :: *@O only if l = LObliv i.e. ~𝔹. For ~𝔹, values are boxed literals [b] and arbitrary b — and ≈ identifies all boxed literals. For 𝟙~+𝟙, values could be [inj@true<...> ()] vs [inj@false<...>()], and ≈ identifies those too (IBoxedInj allows differing b). Hmm so maybe for oblivious types, all well-typed values are ≈ each other? That's the key semantic property! For oblivious type τ (τ :: *@O), any two values of type τ are indistinguishable.

But the theorem statement is more general: e1 and e2 have types τ1, τ2 and e1 ≈ e2. But wait, e1 ≈ e2 with same structure — do they have the same type? e1 ≈ e2 doesn't say anything about τ1 τ2, and we're given ⊥ typing with possibly different types. Hmm.

Hold on, this is a big theorem — this is from the "Oblivious Algebraic Data Types" paper (Zhao, Myers, et al. POPL 2022?) Actually "Oblivious Algebraic Data Types" is a paper by Zhao, Wang, ... let me recall. It's likely from a POPL paper, with Coq mechanization. The task is to prove the "trace obliviousness" theorem. The actual proof would be a large logical-relations proof. But here the file is small — only the statement, with no definitions of logical relations. Hmm, we need to prove from scratch. That seems huge for a "task" but maybe it's intended as the final theorem of a paper, and the library here is a trimmed-down version. We need to find a way to prove it with the given definitions.

Let me think about whether the theorem is actually provable in this setting. Key insight: perhaps there is a much simpler argument. Look at the semantics: nsteps. The claim: if e1 ≈ e2, both well-typed programs (at ⊥ level), then step counts match and results are ≈.

So `if b then...` where b : bool, i.e. EItE l (ELit b) ... And `ite b e1 e2` is notation for if b then e1 else e2 which is EIte LPub (ELit b) e1 e2? From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.base.
From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.syntax.
From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.semantics.
From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.typing.

Import syntax.notations.
Import semantics.notations.
Import typing.notations.

Implicit Types (b : bool) (x X y Y : atom) (L : aset).

(* ---------- free variables ---------- *)
Fixpoint fv (e : expr) : aset :=
  match e with
  | EBVar _ => ∅
  | EFVar x => {[x]}
  | EGVar _ => ∅
  | EUnitT => ∅
  | EUnitV => ∅
  | EBool _ => ∅
  | ELit _ => ∅
  | EProd τ1 τ2 => fv τ1 ∪ fv τ2
  | ESum _ τ1 τ2 => fv τ1 ∪ fv τ2
  | EPi _ τ1 τ2 => fv τ1 ∪ fv τ2
  | EAbs _ τ e => fv τ ∪ fv e
  | EApp e1 e2 => fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | ELet e1 e2 => fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EIte _ e0 e1 e2 => fv e0 ∪ fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EPair e1 e2 => fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EProj _ e => fv e
  | EInj _ _ τ e => fv τ ∪ fv e
  | ECase _ e0 e1 e2 => fv e0 ∪ fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EFold _ e => fv e
  | EUnfold _ e => fv e
  | ESec e => fv e
  | ETape e => fv e
  | EMux e0 e1 e2 => fv e0 ∪ fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EBoxedLit _ => ∅
  | EBoxedInj _ τ e => fv τ ∪ fv e
  end.

Lemma fv_subst_le x s e : fv (subst x s e) ⊆ fv s ∪ fv e.
Proof.
  induction e; simpl; try set_solver.
  case_decide; simpl; set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma subst_not_fv x s e : x ∉ fv e -> subst x s e = e.

(* ---------- context substitution and map lemmas ---------- *)
Definition tctx_subst (x : atom) (s : expr) (Γ : tctx) : tctx :=
  map (fun T : lexpr => (T.1, subst x s T.2)) Γ.

Lemma tctx_subst_lookup x s Γ y :
  tctx_subst x s Γ !! y = option_map (fun T : lexpr => (T.1, subst x s T.2)) (Γ !! y).
Proof. by rewrite /tctx_subst lookup_fmap. Qed.

Lemma tctx_subst_insert x s y T Γ :
  x ≠ y ->
  tctx_subst x s (<[y:=T]>Γ) = <[y:=(T.1, subst x s T.2)]>(tctx_subst x s Γ).
Proof. intros. by rewrite /tctx_subst fmap_insert. Qed.

Lemma tctx_subst_subseteq x s Γ Γ' : Γ ⊆ Γ' -> tctx_subst x s Γ ⊆ tctx_subst x s Γ'.
Proof.
  intros H. apply map_subseteq_spec. intros k w Hk.
  rewrite tctx_subst_lookup in *. rewrite Hk. simpl.
  apply (map_subseteq_spec Γ Γ') in H. specialize (H k).
  rewrite tctx_subst_lookup in H. rewrite Hk in H. simpl in H.
  destruct (Γ!!k); simpl in *; [|done]. by simplify_eq.
Qed.

Lemma map_insert_subset_mono (Γ Γ' : tctx) x T :
  Γ ⊆ Γ' -> <[x:=T]>Γ ⊆ <[x:=T]>Γ'.
Proof.

  - rewrite lookup_insert_eq in Hk. simplify_eq. by rewrite lookup_insert_eq.
  - rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hk by done. by rewrite lookup_insert_ne.
Qed.

Lemma map_subset_insert (Γ : tctx) x T : x ∉ dom Γ -> Γ ⊆ <[x:=T]>Γ.
Proof.

  destruct (decide (x = i)) as [->|Hne].

  - by rewrite lookup_insert_ne.
Qed.

Lemma dom_tctx_subst x s Γ : dom (tctx_subst x s Γ) = dom Γ.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.base.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.syntax.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.semantics.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.typing.

From stdpp Require Import stringmap.

Import syntax.notations.

Import semantics.notations.

Import typing.notations.

Implicit Types (b : bool) (x X y Y : atom) (L : aset).

Definition trace_indistinguishable Σ e1 e2 : Prop :=
  forall n e1',
    Σ ⊨ e1 -->{n} e1' ->
    (exists e2', Σ ⊨ e2 -->{n} e2') /\
    (forall e2', Σ ⊨ e2 -->{n} e2' -> e1' ≈ e2').

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Free variables                                                     *)
(* ================================================================ *)
Fixpoint fv (e : expr) : aset :=
  match e with
  | EBVar _ => ∅
  | EFVar x => {[x]}
  | EGVar _ => ∅
  | EUnitT => ∅
  | EUnitV => ∅
  | EBool _ => ∅
  | ELit _ => ∅
  | EProd τ1 τ2 => fv τ1 ∪ fv τ2
  | ESum _ τ1 τ2 => fv τ1 ∪ fv τ2
  | EPi _ τ1 τ2 => fv τ1 ∪ fv τ2
  | EAbs _ τ e => fv τ ∪ fv e
  | EApp e1 e2 => fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | ELet e1 e2 => fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EIte _ e0 e1 e2 => fv e0 ∪ fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EPair e1 e2 => fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EProj _ e => fv e
  | EInj _ _ τ e => fv τ ∪ fv e
  | ECase _ e0 e1 e2 => fv e0 ∪ fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EFold _ e => fv e
  | EUnfold _ e => fv e
  | ESec e => fv e
  | ETape e => fv e
  | EMux e0 e1 e2 => fv e0 ∪ fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EBoxedLit _ => ∅
  | EBoxedInj _ τ e => fv τ ∪ fv e
  end.

Lemma fv_subst_le x s e : fv (subst x s e) ⊆ fv s ∪ fv e.
Proof.
  induction e; simpl; try set_solver.
  case_decide; simpl; set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma subst_not_fv x s e : x ∉ fv e -> subst x s e = e.
Proof.
  induction e; simpl; intros H; try done; try set_solver;
  try (repeat f_equal; try (apply IHe1; set_solver); try (apply IHe2; set_solver); try (apply IHe3; set_solver); set_solver).
  case_decide; [exfalso; apply H|]; simpl; set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_le : forall (e:expr) (n:nat) (s:expr), fv (open_ n s e) ⊆ fv s ∪ fv e.
Proof.
  induction e; intros n s; simpl; try done; try set_solver;
  try (repeat f_equal; try (apply IHe1; set_solver); try (apply IHe2; set_solver); try (apply IHe3; set_solver); set_solver);
  try (case_decide; simpl; set_solver).
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Locally closed (no free bvars) at depth n                          *)
(* ================================================================ *)
Fixpoint lc_n (n : nat) (e : expr) : Prop :=
  match e with
  | EBVar k => k < n
  | EFVar _ => True
  | EGVar _ => True
  | EUnitT => True
  | EUnitV => True
  | EBool _ => True
  | ELit _ => True
  | EProd τ1 τ2 => lc_n n τ1 /\ lc_n n τ2
  | ESum _ τ1 τ2 => lc_n n τ1 /\ lc_n n τ2
  | EPi _ τ1 τ2 => lc_n n τ1 /\ lc_n (S n) τ2
  | EAbs _ τ e => lc_n n τ /\ lc_n (S n) e
  | EApp e1 e2 => lc_n n e1 /\ lc_n n e2
  | ELet e1 e2 => lc_n n e1 /\ lc_n (S n) e2
  | EIte _ e0 e1 e2 => lc_n n e0 /\ lc_n n e1 /\ lc_n n e2
  | EPair e1 e2 => lc_n n e1 /\ lc_n n e2
  | EProj _ e => lc_n n e
  | EInj _ _ τ e => lc_n n τ /\ lc_n n e
  | ECase _ e0 e1 e2 => lc_n n e0 /\ lc_n (S n) e1 /\ lc_n (S n) e2
  | EFold _ e => lc_n n e
  | EUnfold _ e => lc_n n e
  | ESec e => lc_n n e
  | ETape e => lc_n n e
  | EMux e0 e1 e2 => lc_n n e0 /\ lc_n n e1 /\ lc_n n e2
  | EBoxedLit _ => True
  | EBoxedInj _ τ e => lc_n n τ /\ lc_n n e
  end.

Lemma open_lc_n : forall (e:expr) (nn:nat), lc_n nn e ->
  forall jj, nn <= jj -> forall ss, open_ jj ss e = e.

  let Hyx := fresh "Hyx" in assert (Hyx : xx ≠ y) by (intros ->; apply Hy; set_solver);
  let HyL := fresh "HyL" in assert (HyL : y ∉ L) by set_solver;
  rewrite <- (tctx_subst_insert2 xx vv y l T Γ0 Hyx);
  rewrite <- (subst_open_fvar_lc2 xx vv y E Hn Hyx);
  set (Γ0' := <[y:=(l,T)]>Γ0);
  assert (Heq' : <[y:=(l,T)]>(<[xx:=(lx,τx)]>Γ0) = <[xx:=(lx,τx)]>Γ0')
    by (subst Γ0'; rewrite map_insert_swap by auto; done);
  assert (Hdom' : xx ∉ dom Γ0') by (subst Γ0'; rewrite dom_insert; set_solver);
  assert (Hvv' : Σ; (tctx_subst xx vv Γ0') ⊢ vv :{lx} <{ {xx ↦ vv} τx }>)
    by (subst Γ0'; eapply typing_weaken; [exact Hvv|];
        rewrite (tctx_subst_insert2 xx vv y l T Γ0 Hyx);
        apply map_subset_insert; by apply not_elem_dom_tctx_subst);
  apply (IHbody y HyL Γ0' lx τx Heq' Hdom' Hvv').

Ltac sub_bind xx vv Hn Γ0 lx τx Hvv Σ IHbody Hbody L l T E Ety :=
  let y := fresh "y" in intros y Hy;
  let Hyx := fresh "Hyx" in assert (Hyx : xx ≠ y) by (intros ->; apply Hy; set_solver);
  let HyL := fresh "HyL" in assert (HyL : y ∉ L) by set_solver;
  rewrite <- (tctx_subst_insert2 xx vv y l T Γ0 Hyx);
  rewrite <- (subst_open_fvar_lc2 xx vv y E Hn Hyx);
  rewrite <- (subst_open_fvar_lc2 xx vv y Ety Hn Hyx);
  set (Γ0' := <[y:=(l,T)]>Γ0);
  assert (Heq' : <[y:=(l,T)]>(<[xx:=(lx,τx)]>Γ0) = <[xx:=(lx,τx)]>Γ0')
    by (subst Γ0'; rewrite map_insert_swap by auto; done);
  assert (Hdom' : xx ∉ dom Γ0') by (subst Γ0'; rewrite dom_insert; set_solver);
  assert (Hvv' : Σ; (tctx_subst xx vv Γ0') ⊢ vv :{lx} <{ {xx ↦ vv} τx }>)
    by (subst Γ0'; eapply typing_weaken; [exact Hvv|];
        rewrite (tctx_subst_insert2 xx vv y l T Γ0 Hyx);
        apply map_subset_insert; by apply not_elem_dom_tctx_subst);
  apply (IHbody y HyL Γ0' lx τx Heq' Hdom' Hvv').

Lemma typing_kinding_subst Σ xx vv (Hv : lc vv) (HΣ : xx ∉ gctx_fv Σ) :
  (forall (Γ : tctx) e l τ, Σ; Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ ->
     forall (Γ0 : tctx) (lx : bool) (τx : expr),
       Γ = <[xx:=(lx,τx)]>Γ0 -> xx ∉ dom Γ0 ->
       Σ; (tctx_subst xx vv Γ0) ⊢ vv :{lx} <{ {xx ↦ vv} τx }> ->
       Σ; (tctx_subst xx vv Γ0) ⊢ <{ {xx ↦ vv} e }> :{l} <{ {xx ↦ vv} τ }>) /\
  (forall (Γ : tctx) τ κ, Σ; Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
     forall (Γ0 : tctx) (lx : bool) (τx : expr),
       Γ = <[xx:=(lx,τx)]>Γ0 -> xx ∉ dom Γ0 ->
       Σ; (tctx_subst xx vv Γ0) ⊢ vv :{lx} <{ {xx ↦ vv} τx }> ->
       Σ; (tctx_subst xx vv Γ0) ⊢ <{ {xx ↦ vv} τ }> :: κ).
Proof.
  assert (Hn : lc_n 0 vv) by (apply lc_lc_n0; auto).
  apply (typing_kinding_mutind Σ
    (fun Γ e l τ => forall (Γ0 : tctx) (lx : bool) (τx : expr),
       Γ = <[xx:=(lx,τx)]>Γ0 -> xx ∉ dom Γ0 ->
       Σ; (tctx_subst xx vv Γ0) ⊢ vv :{lx} <{ {xx ↦ vv} τx }> ->
       Σ; (tctx_subst xx vv Γ0) ⊢ <{ {xx ↦ vv} e }> :{l} <{ {xx ↦ vv} τ }>)
    (fun Γ τ κ => forall (Γ0 : tctx) (lx : bool) (τx : expr),
       Γ = <[xx:=(lx,τx)]>Γ0 -> xx ∉ dom Γ0 ->
       Σ; (tctx_subst xx vv Γ0) ⊢ vv :{lx} <{ {xx ↦ vv} τx }> ->
       Σ; (tctx_subst xx vv Γ0) ⊢ <{ {xx ↦ vv} τ }> :: κ)).
  - (* TFVar *) intros Γ x l τ κ Hlk Hk IH Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ.
    destruct (decide (xx = x)) as [->|Hne].
    + rewrite lookup_insert_eq in Hlk. simplify_eq. simpl.
      rewrite decide_True by done. exact Hvv.
    + rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hlk by done.
      simpl. rewrite decide_False by done. eapply TFVar.
      * rewrite tctx_subst_lookup. apply fmap_Some. exists (l,τ). split; [exact Hlk|]. cbn. done.
      * apply (IH Γ0 lx τx); [reflexivity|exact Hdom|exact Hvv].
  - (* TUnit *) intros Γ Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl. apply TUnit.
  - (* TLit *) intros Γ b Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl. apply TLit.
  - (* TFun *) intros Γ x l τ e Hlk Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl.
    assert (Hx : xx ∉ gdef_fv (DFun (l,τ) e)) by (apply (gctx_fv_notin Σ x (DFun (l,τ) e) xx); auto).
    simpl in Hx. assert (Hfτ : xx ∉ fv τ) by set_solver.
    rewrite (subst_not_fv xx vv τ Hfτ). eapply TFun; eauto.
  - (* TAbs *) intros Γ l1 l2 e τ1 τ2 κ L Hbody IHbody Hk IHk Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ.
    simpl. eapply TAbs with (L := L ∪ dom Γ0 ∪ {[xx]}).
    + intros y Hy.
      assert (Hyx : xx ≠ y) by (intros ->; apply Hy; set_solver).
      assert (HyL : y ∉ L) by set_solver.
      rewrite <- (tctx_subst_insert2 xx vv y l2 τ2 Γ0 Hyx).
      rewrite <- (subst_open_fvar_lc2 xx vv y e Hn Hyx).
      rewrite <- (subst_open_fvar_lc2 xx vv y τ1 Hn Hyx).
      set (Γ0' := <[y:=(l2,τ2)]>Γ0).
      assert (Heq' : <[y:=(l2,τ2)]>(<[xx:=(lx,τx)]>Γ0) = <[xx:=(lx,τx)]>Γ0').
      { subst Γ0'. rewrite map_insert_swap by auto. done. }
      assert (Hdom' : xx ∉ dom Γ0').
      { subst Γ0'. rewrite dom_insert. set_solver. }
      assert (Hvv' : Σ; (tctx_subst xx vv Γ0') ⊢ vv :{lx} <{ {xx ↦ vv} τx }>).
      { subst Γ0'. eapply typing_weaken; [exact Hvv|].
        rewrite (tctx_subst_insert2 xx vv y l2 τ2 Γ0 Hyx).
        apply map_subset_insert. by apply not_elem_dom_tctx_subst. }
      apply (IHbody y HyL Γ0' lx τx Heq' Hdom' Hvv').
    + exact (IHk Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
  - (* TLet *) intros Γ l1 l2 l e1 e2 τ1 τ2 L He1 IHe1 Hbody IHbody Hl Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ.
    simpl. rewrite (subst_open_open xx vv e1 τ2 Hn).
    eapply TLet with (L := L ∪ dom Γ0 ∪ {[xx]}).
    + exact (IHe1 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
    + sub_bind xx vv Hn Γ0 lx τx Hvv Σ IHbody Hbody L l1 τ1 e2 τ2.
    + exact Hl.
  - (* TApp *) intros Γ l1 l2 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 He1 IHe1 He2 IHe2 Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ.
    simpl. rewrite (subst_open_open xx vv e2 τ1 Hn). eapply TApp.
    + exact (IHe1 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
    + exact (IHe2 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
  - (* TPair *) intros Γ l1 l2 l e1 e2 τ1 τ2 He1 IHe1 He2 IHe2 Hl Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ.
    simpl. eapply TPair; [exact (IHe1 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)|exact (IHe2 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)|exact Hl].
  - (* TProj *) intros Γ l b e τ1 τ2 He IHe Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ.
    destruct b; simpl;
    [ eapply TProj with (b := true) | eapply TProj with (b := false) ];
    exact (IHe Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
  - (* TInj *) intros Γ l b e τ1 τ2 κ He IHe Hk IHk Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ.
    destruct b.
    + simpl. eapply TInj; [exact (IHe Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv) | exact (IHk Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)].
    + simpl. eapply TInj; [exact (IHe Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv) | exact (IHk Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)].
  - (* TIf *) intros Γ l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ κ He0 IHe0 He1 IHe1 He2 IHe2 Hk IHk Hl Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ.
    simpl. rewrite (subst_open_open xx vv e0 τ Hn).
    eapply TIf.
    + exact (IHe0 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
    + rewrite <- (subst_open_lit xx vv true τ Hn).
      exact (IHe1 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
    + rewrite <- (subst_open_lit xx vv false τ Hn).
      exact (IHe2 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
    + rewrite <- (subst_open_open xx vv e0 τ Hn). exact (IHk Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
    + exact Hl.
  - (* TIfNoDep *) intros Γ l0 l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ He0 IHe0 He1 IHe1 He2 IHe2 Hl Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ.
    simpl. eapply TIfNoDep;
      [ exact (IHe0 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)
      | exact (IHe1 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)
      | exact (IHe2 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)
      | exact Hl ].
  - (* TCase *) intros Γ l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 He0 IHe0 He1 IHe1 He2 IHe2 Hk IHk Hl Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ.
    simpl. rewrite (subst_open_open xx vv e0 τ Hn).
    eapply TCase with (L1 := L1 ∪ dom Γ0 ∪ {[xx]}) (L2 := L2 ∪ dom Γ0 ∪ {[xx]}).
    + exact (IHe0 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
    + intros y Hy.
      assert (Hyx : xx ≠ y) by (intros ->; apply Hy; set_solver).
      assert (HyL : y ∉ L1) by set_solver.
      rewrite <- (tctx_subst_insert2 xx vv y (⊥:bool) τ1 Γ0 Hyx).
      rewrite <- (subst_open_fvar_lc2 xx vv y e1 Hn Hyx).
      rewrite <- (subst_open_inj_l xx vv true τ1 τ2 y τ Hn Hyx).
      set (Γ0' := <[y:=(⊥,τ1)]>Γ0).
      assert (Heq' : <[y:=(⊥,τ1)]>(<[xx:=(lx,τx)]>Γ0) = <[xx:=(lx,τx)]>Γ0').
      { subst Γ0'. rewrite map_insert_swap by auto. done. }
      assert (Hdom' : xx ∉ dom Γ0').
      { subst Γ0'. rewrite dom_insert. set_solver. }
      assert (Hvv' : Σ; (tctx_subst xx vv Γ0') ⊢ vv :{lx} <{ {xx ↦ vv} τx }>).
      { subst Γ0'. eapply typing_weaken; [exact Hvv|].
        rewrite (tctx_subst_insert2 xx vv y (⊥:bool) τ1 Γ0 Hyx).
        apply map_subset_insert. by apply not_elem_dom_tctx_subst. }
      apply (IHe1 y HyL Γ0' lx τx Heq' Hdom' Hvv').
    + intros y Hy.
      assert (Hyx : xx ≠ y) by (intros ->; apply Hy; set_solver).
      assert (HyL : y ∉ L2) by set_solver.
      rewrite <- (tctx_subst_insert2 xx vv y (⊥:bool) τ2 Γ0 Hyx).
      rewrite <- (subst_open_fvar_lc2 xx vv y e2 Hn Hyx).
      rewrite <- (subst_open_inj_l xx vv false τ1 τ2 y τ Hn Hyx).
      set (Γ0' := <[y:=(⊥,τ2)]>Γ0).
      assert (Heq' : <[y:=(⊥,τ2)]>(<[xx:=(lx,τx)]>Γ0) = <[xx:=(lx,τx)]>Γ0').
      { subst Γ0'. rewrite map_insert_swap by auto. done. }
      assert (Hdom' : xx ∉ dom Γ0').
      { subst Γ0'. rewrite dom_insert. set_solver. }
      assert (Hvv' : Σ; (tctx_subst xx vv Γ0') ⊢ vv :{lx} <{ {xx ↦ vv} τx }>).
      { subst Γ0'. eapply typing_weaken; [exact Hvv|].
        rewrite (tctx_subst_insert2 xx vv y (⊥:bool) τ2 Γ0 Hyx).
        apply map_subset_insert. by apply not_elem_dom_tctx_subst. }
      apply (IHe2 y HyL Γ0' lx τx Heq' Hdom' Hvv').
    + rewrite <- (subst_open_open xx vv e0 τ Hn). exact (IHk Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
    + exact Hl.
  - (* TCaseNoDep *) intros Γ l0 l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 He0 IHe0 He1 IHe1 He2 IHe2 Hk IHk Hl Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ.
    simpl. eapply TCaseNoDep with (L1 := L1 ∪ dom Γ0 ∪ {[xx]}) (L2 := L2 ∪ dom Γ0 ∪ {[xx]}).
    + exact (IHe0 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
    + sub_bind xx vv Hn Γ0 lx τx Hvv Σ IHe1 He1 L1 l0 τ1 e1 τ.
    + sub_bind xx vv Hn Γ0 lx τx Hvv Σ IHe2 He2 L2 l0 τ2 e2 τ.
    + exact (IHk Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
    + exact Hl.
  - (* TFold *) intros Γ l X e τ HX He IHe Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl.
    assert (Hx : xx ∉ gdef_fv (DADT τ)) by (apply (gctx_fv_notin Σ X (DADT τ) xx); auto).
    simpl in Hx. rewrite (subst_not_fv xx vv τ Hx). eapply TFold; [exact HX|].
    exact (IHe Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
  - (* TUnfold *) intros Γ l X e τ HX He IHe Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl.
    assert (Hx : xx ∉ gdef_fv (DADT τ)) by (apply (gctx_fv_notin Σ X (DADT τ) xx); auto).
    simpl in Hx. rewrite (subst_not_fv xx vv τ Hx). eapply TUnfold; [exact HX|].
    exact (IHe Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
  - (* TSec *) intros Γ l e He IHe Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl. eapply TSec.
    exact (IHe Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
  - (* TMux *) intros Γ e0 e1 e2 τ He0 IHe0 He1 IHe1 He2 IHe2 Hk IHk Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl.
    eapply TMux;
      [ exact (IHe0 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)
      | exact (IHe1 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)
      | exact (IHe2 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)
      | exact (IHk Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv) ].
  - (* TOInj *) intros Γ b e τ1 τ2 He IHe Hk IHk Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ.
    destruct b.
    + simpl. eapply TOInj; [exact (IHe Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv) | exact (IHk Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)].
    + simpl. eapply TOInj; [exact (IHe Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv) | exact (IHk Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)].
  - (* TOIf *) intros Γ l1 l2 e0 e1 e2 τ κ He0 IHe0 He1 IHe1 He2 IHe2 Hk IHk Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl.
    eapply TOIf;
      [ exact (IHe0 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)
      | exact (IHe1 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)
      | exact (IHe2 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)
      | exact (IHk Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv) ].
  - (* TOCase *) intros Γ l1 l2 e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 He0 IHe0 He1 IHe1 He2 IHe2 Hk IHk Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl.
    eapply TOCase with (L1 := L1 ∪ dom Γ0 ∪ {[xx]}) (L2 := L2 ∪ dom Γ0 ∪ {[xx]}).
    + exact (IHe0 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
    + sub_bind xx vv Hn Γ0 lx τx Hvv Σ IHe1 He1 L1 (⊥:bool) τ1 e1 τ.
    + sub_bind xx vv Hn Γ0 lx τx Hvv Σ IHe2 He2 L2 (⊥:bool) τ2 e2 τ.
    + exact (IHk Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
  - (* TTape *) intros Γ l e τ He IHe Hk IHk Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl. eapply TTape;
      [ exact (IHe Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv) | exact (IHk Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv) ].
  - (* TBoxedLit *) intros Γ b Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl. apply TBoxedLit.
  - (* TBoxedInj *) intros Γ b v ω Hov Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl.
    assert (Ho : otval ω) by (apply ovalty_otval; exact Hov).
    assert (Hx : xx ∉ fv ω) by (apply otval_not_fv; auto).
    rewrite (subst_not_fv xx vv ω Hx). exact (TBoxedInj Σ Γ0 b v ω Hov).
  - (* TConv *) intros Γ l l' e τ τ' κ He IHe Hpe Hk IHk Hle Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ.
    eapply TConv.
    + exact (IHe Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
    + apply (pared_equiv_subst Σ xx vv Hv HΣ); auto.
    + exact (IHk Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
    + exact Hle.
  - (* KADT *) intros Γ X τ HX Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl. apply KADT. exact HX.
  - (* KUnit *) intros Γ Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl. apply KUnit.
  - (* KBool *) intros Γ l Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl. apply KBool.
  - (* KPi *) intros Γ l τ1 τ2 κ1 κ2 L Hbody IHbody Hk IHk Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl.
    eapply KPi with (L := L ∪ dom Γ0 ∪ {[xx]}).
    + sub_bind_kind xx vv Hn Γ0 lx τx Hvv Σ IHbody Hbody L l τ1 τ2.
    + exact (IHk Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
  - (* KProd *) intros Γ τ1 τ2 κ H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl.
    eapply KProd; [exact (IH1 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)|exact (IH2 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)].
  - (* KSum *) intros Γ τ1 τ2 κ H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl.
    eapply KSum; [exact (IH1 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)|exact (IH2 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)].
  - (* KOSum *) intros Γ τ1 τ2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl.
    eapply KOSum; [exact (IH1 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)|exact (IH2 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)].
  - (* KOADT *) intros Γ e' e τ X HX He IHe Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl.
    assert (Hx : xx ∉ gdef_fv (DOADT τ e')) by (apply (gctx_fv_notin Σ X (DOADT τ e') xx); auto).
    simpl in Hx. assert (Hfτ : xx ∉ fv τ) by set_solver.
    rewrite (subst_not_fv xx vv τ Hfτ). eapply KOADT; [exact HX|].
    exact (IHe Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
  - (* KIf *) intros Γ e0 τ1 τ2 He IHe H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl.
    eapply KIf; [exact (IHe Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)|exact (IH1 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)|exact (IH2 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)].
  - (* KCase *) intros Γ e0 τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' L1 L2 He0 IHe0 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl.
    eapply KCase with (L1 := L1 ∪ dom Γ0 ∪ {[xx]}) (L2 := L2 ∪ dom Γ0 ∪ {[xx]}).
    + exact (IHe0 Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
    + sub_bind_kind xx vv Hn Γ0 lx τx Hvv Σ IH1 H1 L1 (⊥:bool) τ1' τ1.
    + sub_bind_kind xx vv Hn Γ0 lx τx Hvv Σ IH2 H2 L2 (⊥:bool) τ2' τ2.
  - (* KLet *) intros Γ e τ τ' L He IHe H1 IH1 Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl.
    eapply KLet with (L := L ∪ dom Γ0 ∪ {[xx]}).
    + exact (IHe Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv).
    + sub_bind_kind xx vv Hn Γ0 lx τx Hvv Σ IH1 H1 L (⊥:bool) τ' τ.
  - (* KSub *) intros Γ τ κ κ' Hk IHk Hle Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv. subst Γ. simpl.
    eapply KSub; [exact (IHk Γ0 lx τx eq_refl Hdom Hvv)|exact Hle].
Qed.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.syntax.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.semantics.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.typing.

Definition trace_indistinguishable Σ e1 e2 : Prop :=
  forall n e1',

340	#[local]
341	Coercion EFVar : atom >-> expr.
342	
343	Reserved Notation "e '≈' e'" (at level 40).
344	
345	Inductive indistinguishable : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
346	| IBVar k : <{ bvar k }> ≈ <{ bvar k }>
347	| IFVar x : <{ fvar x }> ≈ <{ fvar x }>
348	| IGVar x : <{ gvar x }> ≈ <{ gvar x }>
349	| IPi l τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :
350	    τ1 ≈ τ1' ->
351	    τ2 ≈ τ2' ->
352	    <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }> ≈ <{ Π:{l}τ1', τ2' }>
353	| IAbs l τ τ' e e' :
354	    τ ≈ τ' ->
355	    e ≈ e' ->
356	    <{ \:{l}τ => e }> ≈ <{ \:{l}τ' => e' }>
357	| IApp e1 e1' e2 e2' :
358	    e1 ≈ e1' ->
359	    e2 ≈ e2' ->
360	    <{ e1 e2 }> ≈ <{ e1' e2' }>
361	| ILet e1 e1' e2 e2' :
362	    e1 ≈ e1' ->
363	    e2 ≈ e2' ->
364	    <{ let e1 in e2 }> ≈ <{ let e1' in e2' }>
365	| IUnitT : <{ 𝟙 }> ≈ <{ 𝟙 }>
366	| IUnitV : <{ () }> ≈ <{ () }>
367	| IBool l : <{ 𝔹{l} }> ≈ <{ 𝔹{l} }>
368	| ILit b : <{ lit b }> ≈ <{ lit b }>
369	| ISec e e' :
370	    e ≈ e' ->
371	    <{ s𝔹 e }> ≈ <{ s𝔹 e' }>
372	| IIte l e0 e0' e1 e1' e2 e2' :
373	    e0 ≈ e0' ->
374	    e1 ≈ e1' ->
375	    e2 ≈ e2' ->
376	    <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }> ≈ <{ if{l} e0' then e1' else e2' }>
377	| IProd τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :
378	    τ1 ≈ τ1' ->
379	    τ2 ≈ τ2' ->
380	    <{ τ1 * τ2 }> ≈ <{ τ1' * τ2' }>
381	| IPair e1 e1' e2 e2' :
382	    e1 ≈ e1' ->
383	    e2 ≈ e2' ->
384	    <{ (e1, e2) }> ≈ <{ (e1', e2') }>
385	| IProj b e e' :
386	    e ≈ e' ->
387	    <{ π@b e }> ≈ <{ π@b e' }>
388	| ISum l τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :
389	    τ1 ≈ τ1' ->
390	    τ2 ≈ τ2' ->
391	    <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }> ≈ <{ τ1' +{l} τ2' }>
392	| IInj l b τ τ' e e' :
393	    τ ≈ τ' ->
394	    e ≈ e' ->
395	    <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }> ≈ <{ inj{l}@b<τ'> e' }>
396	| ICase l e0 e0' e1 e1' e2 e2' :
397	    e0 ≈ e0' ->
398	    e1 ≈ e1' ->
399	    e2 ≈ e2' ->
400	    <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }> ≈ <{ case{l} e0' of e1' | e2' }>
401	| IFold X e e' :
402	    e ≈ e' ->
403	    <{ fold<X> e }> ≈ <{ fold<X> e' }>
404	| IUnfold X e e' :
405	    e ≈ e' ->
406	    <{ unfold<X> e }> ≈ <{ unfold<X> e' }>
407	| ITape e e' :
408	    e ≈ e' ->
409	    <{ tape e }> ≈ <{ tape e' }>
410	| IMux e0 e0' e1 e1' e2 e2' :
411	    e0 ≈ e0' ->
412	    e1 ≈ e1' ->
413	    e2 ≈ e2' ->
414	    <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }> ≈ <{ mux e0' e1' e2' }>
415	
416	| IBoxedLit b b' :
417	
418	    <{ [b] }> ≈ <{ [b'] }>
419	| IBoxedInj b b' τ e e' :
420	
421	    <{ [inj@b<τ> e] }> ≈ <{ [inj@b'<τ> e'] }>
422	
423	where "e '≈' e'" := (indistinguishable e e').
