425	Reserved Notation "'{' k '~>' s '}' e" (in custom oadt at level 20, k constr).
426	
427	Fixpoint open_ (k : nat) (s : expr) (e : expr) : expr :=
428	  match e with
429	  | <{ bvar n }> => if decide (k = n) then s else e
430	  | <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }> => <{ Π:{l}({k~>s}τ1), {S k~>s}τ2 }>
431	  | <{ \:{l}τ => e }> => <{ \:{l}({k~>s}τ) => {S k~>s}e }>
432	  | <{ let e1 in e2 }> => <{ let {k~>s}e1 in {S k~>s}e2 }>
433	  | <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }> => <{ case{l} {k~>s}e0 of {S k~>s}e1 | {S k~>s}e2 }>
434	
435	  | <{ e1 e2 }> => <{ ({k~>s}e1) ({k~>s}e2) }>
436	  | <{ s𝔹 e }> => <{ s𝔹 ({k~>s}e) }>
437	  | <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }> => <{ if{l} {k~>s}e0 then {k~>s}e1 else {k~>s}e2 }>
438	  | <{ τ1 * τ2 }> => <{ ({k~>s}τ1) * ({k~>s}τ2) }>
439	  | <{ (e1, e2) }> => <{ ({k~>s}e1, {k~>s}e2) }>
440	  | <{ π@b e }> => <{ π@b ({k~>s}e) }>
441	  | <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }> => <{ ({k~>s}τ1) +{l} ({k~>s}τ2) }>
442	  | <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }> => <{ inj{l}@b<({k~>s}τ)> ({k~>s}e) }>
443	  | <{ fold<X> e }> => <{ fold<X> ({k~>s}e) }>
444	  | <{ unfold<X> e }> => <{ unfold<X> ({k~>s}e) }>
445	  | <{ tape e }> => <{ tape ({k~>s}e) }>
446	  | <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }> => <{ mux ({k~>s}e0) ({k~>s}e1) ({k~>s}e2) }>
447	  | _ => e
448	  end
449	
450	where "'{' k '~>' s '}' e" := (open_ k s e) (in custom oadt).
451	
452	Definition open s e := open_ 0 s e.
453	
454	Notation "e ^ s" := (open s e) (in custom oadt at level 20).
455	
456	Reserved Notation "'{' x '↦' s '}' e" (in custom oadt at level 20, x constr).
457	
458	Fixpoint subst (x : atom) (s : expr) (e : expr) : expr :=
459	  match e with
460	  | <{ fvar y }> => if decide (x = y) then s else e
461	
462	  | <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }> => <{ Π:{l}({x↦s}τ1), {x↦s}τ2 }>
463	  | <{ \:{l}τ => e }> => <{ \:{l}({x↦s}τ) => {x↦s}e }>
464	  | <{ e1 e2 }> => <{ ({x↦s}e1) ({x↦s}e2) }>
465	  | <{ let e1 in e2 }> => <{ let {x↦s}e1 in {x↦s}e2 }>
466	  | <{ s𝔹 e }> => <{ s𝔹 ({x↦s}e) }>
467	  | <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }> => <{ if{l} {x↦s}e0 then {x↦s}e1 else {x↦s}e2 }>
468	  | <{ τ1 * τ2 }> => <{ ({x↦s}τ1) * ({x↦s}τ2) }>
469	  | <{ (e1, e2) }> => <{ ({x↦s}e1, {x↦s}e2) }>
470	  | <{ π@b e }> => <{ π@b ({x↦s}e) }>
471	  | <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }> => <{ ({x↦s}τ1) +{l} ({x↦s}τ2) }>
472	  | <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }> => <{ inj{l}@b<({x↦s}τ)> ({x↦s}e) }>
473	  | <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }> => <{ case{l} {x↦s}e0 of {x↦s}e1 | {x↦s}e2 }>
474	  | <{ fold<X> e }> => <{ fold<X> ({x↦s}e) }>
475	  | <{ unfold<X> e }> => <{ unfold<X> ({x↦s}e) }>
476	  | <{ tape e }> => <{ tape ({x↦s}e) }>
477	  | <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }> => <{ mux ({x↦s}e0) ({x↦s}e1) ({x↦s}e2) }>
478	  | _ => e
479	  end
480	
481	where "'{' x '↦' s '}' e" := (subst x s e) (in custom oadt).
482	
483	Definition lexpr_subst x s (T : lexpr) := (T.1, subst x s T.2).
484	
485	Inductive otval : expr -> Prop :=
486	| OVUnitT : otval <{ 𝟙 }>
487	| OVOBool : otval <{ ~𝔹 }>
488	| OVProd ω1 ω2 : otval ω1 -> otval ω2 -> otval <{ ω1 * ω2 }>
489	| OVOSum ω1 ω2 : otval ω1 -> otval ω2 -> otval <{ ω1 ~+ ω2 }>
490	.
491	
492	Inductive oval : expr -> Prop :=
493	| OVUnitV : oval <{ () }>
494	| OVBoxedLit b : oval <{ [b] }>
495	| OVPair v1 v2 : oval v1 -> oval v2 -> oval <{ (v1, v2) }>
496	| OVBoxedInj b ω v : otval ω -> oval v -> oval <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>
497	.
498	
499	Inductive val : expr -> Prop :=
500	| VUnitV : val <{ () }>
501	| VLit b : val <{ lit b }>
502	| VPair v1 v2 : val v1 -> val v2 -> val <{ (v1, v2) }>
503	| VAbs l τ e : val <{ \:{l}τ => e }>
504	| VInj b τ v : val v -> val <{ inj@b<τ> v }>
505	| VFold X v : val v -> val <{ fold<X> v }>
506	| VBoxedLit b : val <{ [b] }>
507	| VBoxedInj b ω v : otval ω -> oval v -> val <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>
508	.
509	
510	Inductive lc : expr -> Prop :=
511	| LCFVar x : lc <{ fvar x }>
512	| LCGVar x : lc <{ gvar x }>
513	| LCPi l τ1 τ2 L :
514	    (forall x, x ∉ L -> lc <{ τ2^x }>) ->
515	    lc τ1 -> lc <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }>
516	| LCAbs l τ e L :
517	    (forall x, x ∉ L -> lc <{ e^x }>) ->
518	    lc τ -> lc <{ \:{l}τ => e }>
519	| LCLet e1 e2 L :
520	    (forall x, x ∉ L -> lc <{ e2^x }>) ->
521	    lc e1 -> lc <{ let e1 in e2 }>
522	| LCCase l e0 e1 e2 L1 L2 :
523	    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> lc <{ e1^x }>) ->
524	    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> lc <{ e2^x }>) ->
525	    lc e0 -> lc <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }>
526	
527	| LCUnitT : lc <{ 𝟙 }>
528	| LCUnitV : lc <{ () }>
529	| LCBool l : lc <{ 𝔹{l} }>
530	| LCApp e1 e2 : lc e1 -> lc e2 -> lc <{ e1 e2 }>
531	| LCLit b : lc <{ lit b }>
532	| LCSec e : lc e -> lc <{ s𝔹 e }>
533	| LCIte l e0 e1 e2 : lc e0 -> lc e1 -> lc e2 -> lc <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }>
534	| LCProd τ1 τ2 : lc τ1 -> lc τ2 -> lc <{ τ1 * τ2 }>
535	| LCPair e1 e2 : lc e1 -> lc e2 -> lc <{ (e1, e2) }>
536	| LCProj b e : lc e -> lc <{ π@b e }>
537	| LCSum l τ1 τ2 : lc τ1 -> lc τ2 -> lc <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }>
538	| LCInj l b τ e : lc τ -> lc e -> lc <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }>
539	| LCFold X e : lc e -> lc <{ fold<X> e }>
540	| LCUnfold X e : lc e -> lc <{ unfold<X> e }>
541	| LCTape e : lc e -> lc <{ tape e }>
542	| LCMux e0 e1 e2 : lc e0 -> lc e1 -> lc e2 -> lc <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }>
543	| LCBoxedLit b : lc <{ [b] }>
544	
545	| LCBoxedInj b ω v : otval ω -> oval v -> lc <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>
546	.
547	
548	End definitions.

557	                                   (in custom oadt at level 20, k constr).

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.base.

Implicit Types (b : bool) (x X y Y : atom) (L : aset).

Open Scope type_scope.

Notation olabel := bool (only parsing).

Notation LObliv := true (only parsing).

Notation LPub := false (only parsing).

Notation llabel := bool (only parsing).

Notation LLeak := true (only parsing).

Notation LSafe := false (only parsing).

Inductive expr :=

| EBVar (k : nat)

| EFVar (x : atom)

| EGVar (x : atom)

| EUnitT

| EBool (l : olabel)
| EProd (τ1 τ2 : expr)

| ESum (l : olabel) (τ1 τ2 : expr)

| EPi (l : llabel) (τ1 τ2: expr)

| EUnitV
| ELit (b : bool)

| EAbs (l : llabel) (τ e : expr)

| EApp (e1 e2 : expr)

| ELet (e1 e2 : expr)

| EIte (l : olabel) (e0 e1 e2 : expr)

| EPair (e1 e2 : expr)
| EProj (b : bool) (e : expr)

| EInj (l : olabel) (b : bool) (τ e : expr)

| ECase (l : olabel) (e0 : expr) (e1 : expr) (e2 : expr)

| EFold (X : atom) (e : expr)
| EUnfold (X : atom) (e : expr)

| ESec (e : expr)

| ETape (e : expr)

| EMux (e0 e1 e2 : expr)

| EBoxedLit (b : bool)
| EBoxedInj (b : bool) (τ e : expr)
.

Definition lexpr := (llabel * expr).

Definition lexpr_label : lexpr -> llabel := fst.

Arguments lexpr_label /.

Definition lexpr_expr : lexpr -> expr := snd.

Arguments lexpr_expr /.

Variant gdef :=
| DADT (e : expr)
| DFun (T : lexpr) (e : expr)
| DOADT (τ e : expr)
.

Notation gctx := (amap gdef).

Notation program := (gctx * expr).

Module expr_notations.

Coercion ELit : bool >-> expr.

Coercion lexpr_expr : lexpr >-> expr.

Notation "<{ e }>" := e (e custom oadt at level 99).

Notation "',(' e ')'" := e (in custom oadt at level 0,
                               e constr at level 0).

Notation "( x )" := x (in custom oadt, x at level 99).

Notation "x" := x (in custom oadt at level 0, x constr at level 0).

Notation "'bvar' x" := (EBVar x) (in custom oadt at level 0, x constr at level 0).

Notation "'fvar' x" := (EFVar x) (in custom oadt at level 0, x constr at level 0,
                                     only parsing).

Notation "'gvar' x" := (EGVar x) (in custom oadt at level 0, x constr at level 0).

Notation "'lit' b" := (ELit b) (in custom oadt at level 0, b constr at level 0,
                                   only parsing).

Notation "'𝟙'" := EUnitT (in custom oadt at level 0).

Notation "'Unit'" := EUnitT (in custom oadt at level 0, only parsing).

Notation "'𝔹{' l '}'" := (EBool l) (in custom oadt at level 0,
                                       l constr at level 0,
                                       format "'𝔹{' l '}'").

Notation "'𝔹'" := (EBool LPub) (in custom oadt at level 0).

Notation "'Bool'" := (EBool LPub) (in custom oadt at level 0, only parsing).

Notation "'~𝔹'" := (EBool LObliv) (in custom oadt at level 0).

Notation "'~Bool'" := (EBool LObliv) (in custom oadt at level 0, only parsing).

Notation "τ1 * τ2" := (EProd τ1 τ2) (in custom oadt at level 3,
                                        τ1 custom oadt,
                                        τ2 custom oadt at level 0).

Notation "τ1 '+{' l '}' τ2" := (ESum l τ1 τ2) (in custom oadt at level 4,
                                                  l constr at level 0,
                                                  left associativity,
                                                  format "τ1  '+{' l '}'  τ2").

Notation "τ1 + τ2" := (ESum LPub τ1 τ2) (in custom oadt at level 4,
                                            left associativity).

Notation "τ1 ~+ τ2" := (ESum LObliv τ1 τ2) (in custom oadt at level 4,
                                               left associativity).

Notation "'Π' :{ l } τ1 , τ2" := (EPi l τ1 τ2)
                                   (in custom oadt at level 50,
                                       right associativity,
                                       format "Π :{ l } τ1 ,  τ2").

Notation "'Π' : τ1 , τ2" := (EPi LSafe τ1 τ2)
                              (in custom oadt at level 50,
                                  right associativity,
                                  format "Π : τ1 ,  τ2").

Notation "'Π' ~: τ1 , τ2" := (EPi LLeak τ1 τ2)
                               (in custom oadt at level 50,
                                   right associativity,
                                   format "Π ~: τ1 ,  τ2").

Notation "\ :{ l } τ '=>' e" := (EAbs l τ e)
                                  (in custom oadt at level 90,
                                      τ custom oadt at level 99,
                                      e custom oadt at level 99,
                                      left associativity,
                                      format "\ :{ l } τ  =>  e").

Notation "\ : τ '=>' e" := (EAbs LSafe τ e)
                             (in custom oadt at level 90,
                                 τ custom oadt at level 99,
                                 e custom oadt at level 99,
                                 left associativity,
                                 format "\ : τ  =>  e").

Notation "\ ~: τ '=>' e" := (EAbs LLeak τ e)
                              (in custom oadt at level 90,
                                  τ custom oadt at level 99,
                                  e custom oadt at level 99,
                                  left associativity,
                                  format "\ ~: τ  =>  e").

Notation "e1 e2" := (EApp e1 e2) (in custom oadt at level 2, left associativity).

Notation "()" := EUnitV (in custom oadt at level 0).

Notation "( x , y , .. , z )" := (EPair .. (EPair x y) .. z)
                                   (in custom oadt at level 0,
                                       x custom oadt at level 99,
                                       y custom oadt at level 99,
                                       z custom oadt at level 99).

Notation "'π@' b e" := (EProj b e) (in custom oadt at level 2,
                                       b constr at level 0,
                                       format "π@ b  e").

Notation "'π1' e" := (EProj true e) (in custom oadt at level 2).

Notation "'π2' e" := (EProj false e) (in custom oadt at level 2).

Notation "'s𝔹' e" := (ESec e) (in custom oadt at level 2).

Notation "'if{' l '}' e0 'then' e1 'else' e2" := (EIte l e0 e1 e2)
                                                   (in custom oadt at level 89,
                                                       l constr at level 0,
                                                       e0 custom oadt at level 99,
                                                       e1 custom oadt at level 99,
                                                       e2 custom oadt at level 99,
                                                       left associativity,
                                                       format "'if{' l '}'  e0  'then'  e1  'else'  e2").

Notation "'if' e0 'then' e1 'else' e2" := (EIte LPub e0 e1 e2)
                                            (in custom oadt at level 89,
                                                e0 custom oadt at level 99,
                                                e1 custom oadt at level 99,
                                                e2 custom oadt at level 99,
                                                left associativity).

| IGVar x : <{ gvar x }> ≈ <{ gvar x }>
| IPi l τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :

    τ2 ≈ τ2' ->
    <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }> ≈ <{ Π:{l}τ1', τ2' }>
| IAbs l τ τ' e e' :
    τ ≈ τ' ->

    e1 ≈ e1' ->
    e2 ≈ e2' ->

| IUnitV : <{ () }> ≈ <{ () }>

| ISec e e' :
    e ≈ e' ->
    <{ s𝔹 e }> ≈ <{ s𝔹 e' }>
| IIte l e0 e0' e1 e1' e2 e2' :
    e0 ≈ e0' ->
    e1 ≈ e1' ->
    e2 ≈ e2' ->
    <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }> ≈ <{ if{l} e0' then e1' else e2' }>
| IProd τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :
    τ1 ≈ τ1' ->
    τ2 ≈ τ2' ->
    <{ τ1 * τ2 }> ≈ <{ τ1' * τ2' }>
| IPair e1 e1' e2 e2' :
    e1 ≈ e1' ->
    e2 ≈ e2' ->
    <{ (e1, e2) }> ≈ <{ (e1', e2') }>
| IProj b e e' :
    e ≈ e' ->
    <{ π@b e }> ≈ <{ π@b e' }>
| ISum l τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :
    τ1 ≈ τ1' ->
    τ2 ≈ τ2' ->
    <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }> ≈ <{ τ1' +{l} τ2' }>
| IInj l b τ τ' e e' :
    τ ≈ τ' ->
    e ≈ e' ->
    <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }> ≈ <{ inj{l}@b<τ'> e' }>
| ICase l e0 e0' e1 e1' e2 e2' :
    e0 ≈ e0' ->
    e1 ≈ e1' ->
    e2 ≈ e2' ->
    <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }> ≈ <{ case{l} e0' of e1' | e2' }>
| IFold X e e' :
    e ≈ e' ->
    <{ fold<X> e }> ≈ <{ fold<X> e' }>
| IUnfold X e e' :
    e ≈ e' ->
    <{ unfold<X> e }> ≈ <{ unfold<X> e' }>
| ITape e e' :
    e ≈ e' ->
    <{ tape e }> ≈ <{ tape e' }>
| IMux e0 e0' e1 e1' e2 e2' :
    e0 ≈ e0' ->
    e1 ≈ e1' ->
    e2 ≈ e2' ->
    <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }> ≈ <{ mux e0' e1' e2' }>

    <{ [b] }> ≈ <{ [b'] }>

where "e '≈' e'" := (indistinguishable e e').

Reserved Notation "'{' k '~>' s '}' e" (in custom oadt at level 20, k constr).

Fixpoint open_ (k : nat) (s : expr) (e : expr) : expr :=
  match e with
  | <{ bvar n }> => if decide (k = n) then s else e
  | <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }> => <{ Π:{l}({k~>s}τ1), {S k~>s}τ2 }>
  | <{ \:{l}τ => e }> => <{ \:{l}({k~>s}τ) => {S k~>s}e }>
  | <{ let e1 in e2 }> => <{ let {k~>s}e1 in {S k~>s}e2 }>
  | <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }> => <{ case{l} {k~>s}e0 of {S k~>s}e1 | {S k~>s}e2 }>

  | <{ e1 e2 }> => <{ ({k~>s}e1) ({k~>s}e2) }>
  | <{ s𝔹 e }> => <{ s𝔹 ({k~>s}e) }>
  | <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }> => <{ if{l} {k~>s}e0 then {k~>s}e1 else {k~>s}e2 }>
  | <{ τ1 * τ2 }> => <{ ({k~>s}τ1) * ({k~>s}τ2) }>
  | <{ (e1, e2) }> => <{ ({k~>s}e1, {k~>s}e2) }>
  | <{ π@b e }> => <{ π@b ({k~>s}e) }>
  | <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }> => <{ ({k~>s}τ1) +{l} ({k~>s}τ2) }>
  | <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }> => <{ inj{l}@b<({k~>s}τ)> ({k~>s}e) }>
  | <{ fold<X> e }> => <{ fold<X> ({k~>s}e) }>
  | <{ unfold<X> e }> => <{ unfold<X> ({k~>s}e) }>
  | <{ tape e }> => <{ tape ({k~>s}e) }>
  | <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }> => <{ mux ({k~>s}e0) ({k~>s}e1) ({k~>s}e2) }>
  | _ => e
  end

where "'{' k '~>' s '}' e" := (open_ k s e) (in custom oadt).

Definition open s e := open_ 0 s e.

Notation "e ^ s" := (open s e) (in custom oadt at level 20).

Reserved Notation "'{' x '↦' s '}' e" (in custom oadt at level 20, x constr).

Fixpoint subst (x : atom) (s : expr) (e : expr) : expr :=
  match e with
  | <{ fvar y }> => if decide (x = y) then s else e

  | <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }> => <{ Π:{l}({x↦s}τ1), {x↦s}τ2 }>
  | <{ \:{l}τ => e }> => <{ \:{l}({x↦s}τ) => {x↦s}e }>
  | <{ e1 e2 }> => <{ ({x↦s}e1) ({x↦s}e2) }>
  | <{ let e1 in e2 }> => <{ let {x↦s}e1 in {x↦s}e2 }>
  | <{ s𝔹 e }> => <{ s𝔹 ({x↦s}e) }>
  | <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }> => <{ if{l} {x↦s}e0 then {x↦s}e1 else {x↦s}e2 }>
  | <{ τ1 * τ2 }> => <{ ({x↦s}τ1) * ({x↦s}τ2) }>
  | <{ (e1, e2) }> => <{ ({x↦s}e1, {x↦s}e2) }>
  | <{ π@b e }> => <{ π@b ({x↦s}e) }>
  | <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }> => <{ ({x↦s}τ1) +{l} ({x↦s}τ2) }>
  | <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }> => <{ inj{l}@b<({x↦s}τ)> ({x↦s}e) }>
  | <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }> => <{ case{l} {x↦s}e0 of {x↦s}e1 | {x↦s}e2 }>
  | <{ fold<X> e }> => <{ fold<X> ({x↦s}e) }>
  | <{ unfold<X> e }> => <{ unfold<X> ({x↦s}e) }>
  | <{ tape e }> => <{ tape ({x↦s}e) }>
  | <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }> => <{ mux ({x↦s}e0) ({x↦s}e1) ({x↦s}e2) }>
  | _ => e
  end

where "'{' x '↦' s '}' e" := (subst x s e) (in custom oadt).

Definition lexpr_subst x s (T : lexpr) := (T.1, subst x s T.2).

Inductive otval : expr -> Prop :=
| OVUnitT : otval <{ 𝟙 }>
| OVOBool : otval <{ ~𝔹 }>
| OVProd ω1 ω2 : otval ω1 -> otval ω2 -> otval <{ ω1 * ω2 }>
| OVOSum ω1 ω2 : otval ω1 -> otval ω2 -> otval <{ ω1 ~+ ω2 }>
.

Inductive oval : expr -> Prop :=
| OVUnitV : oval <{ () }>
| OVBoxedLit b : oval <{ [b] }>
| OVPair v1 v2 : oval v1 -> oval v2 -> oval <{ (v1, v2) }>
| OVBoxedInj b ω v : otval ω -> oval v -> oval <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>
.

Inductive val : expr -> Prop :=
| VUnitV : val <{ () }>
| VLit b : val <{ lit b }>
| VPair v1 v2 : val v1 -> val v2 -> val <{ (v1, v2) }>
| VAbs l τ e : val <{ \:{l}τ => e }>
| VInj b τ v : val v -> val <{ inj@b<τ> v }>
| VFold X v : val v -> val <{ fold<X> v }>
| VBoxedLit b : val <{ [b] }>
| VBoxedInj b ω v : otval ω -> oval v -> val <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>
.

Inductive lc : expr -> Prop :=
| LCFVar x : lc <{ fvar x }>
| LCGVar x : lc <{ gvar x }>
| LCPi l τ1 τ2 L :
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> lc <{ τ2^x }>) ->
    lc τ1 -> lc <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }>
| LCAbs l τ e L :
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> lc <{ e^x }>) ->
    lc τ -> lc <{ \:{l}τ => e }>
| LCLet e1 e2 L :
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> lc <{ e2^x }>) ->
    lc e1 -> lc <{ let e1 in e2 }>
| LCCase l e0 e1 e2 L1 L2 :
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> lc <{ e1^x }>) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> lc <{ e2^x }>) ->
    lc e0 -> lc <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }>

| LCUnitT : lc <{ 𝟙 }>
| LCUnitV : lc <{ () }>
| LCBool l : lc <{ 𝔹{l} }>
| LCApp e1 e2 : lc e1 -> lc e2 -> lc <{ e1 e2 }>
| LCLit b : lc <{ lit b }>
| LCSec e : lc e -> lc <{ s𝔹 e }>
| LCIte l e0 e1 e2 : lc e0 -> lc e1 -> lc e2 -> lc <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }>
| LCProd τ1 τ2 : lc τ1 -> lc τ2 -> lc <{ τ1 * τ2 }>
| LCPair e1 e2 : lc e1 -> lc e2 -> lc <{ (e1, e2) }>
| LCProj b e : lc e -> lc <{ π@b e }>
| LCSum l τ1 τ2 : lc τ1 -> lc τ2 -> lc <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }>
| LCInj l b τ e : lc τ -> lc e -> lc <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }>
| LCFold X e : lc e -> lc <{ fold<X> e }>
| LCUnfold X e : lc e -> lc <{ unfold<X> e }>
| LCTape e : lc e -> lc <{ tape e }>
| LCMux e0 e1 e2 : lc e0 -> lc e1 -> lc e2 -> lc <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }>
| LCBoxedLit b : lc <{ [b] }>

| LCBoxedInj b ω v : otval ω -> oval v -> lc <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>
.

End definitions.

132	| ROIfIf b e1 e2 e3 e4 e1' e2' e3' e4' :
133	    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
134	    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
135	    e3 ⇛ e3' ->
136	    e4 ⇛ e4' ->
137	    <{ if (~if [b] then e1 else e2) then e3 else e4 }> ⇛
138	      <{ ~if [b] then (if e1' then e3' else e4') else (if e2' then e3' else e4') }>
139	| ROIfProj b b' e1 e2 e1' e2' :
140	    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
141	    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
142	    <{ π@b' (~if [b] then e1 else e2) }> ⇛
143	      <{ ~if [b] then π@b' e1' else π@b' e2' }>
144	| ROIfCase b e1 e2 e3 e4 e1' e2' e3' e4' L1 L2 :
145	    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
146	    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
147	    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <{ e3^x }> ⇛ <{ e3'^x }>) ->
148	    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <{ e4^x }> ⇛ <{ e4'^x }>) ->
149	    <{ case (~if [b] then e1 else e2) of e3 | e4 }> ⇛
150	      <{ ~if [b] then (case e1' of e3' | e4') else (case e2' of e3' | e4') }>
151	| ROIfUnfold X b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
152	    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
153	    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
154	    <{ unfold<X> (~if [b] then e1 else e2) }> ⇛
155	      <{ ~if [b] then unfold<X> e1' else unfold<X> e2' }>
156	| RTapeOIf b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
157	    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
158	    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
159	    <{ tape (~if [b] then e1 else e2) }> ⇛ <{ mux [b] (tape e1') (tape e2') }>
160	| RTapePair e1 e2 e1' e2' :
161	    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
162	    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
163	    woval e1 -> woval e2 ->
164	    <{ tape (e1, e2) }> ⇛ <{ (tape e1', tape e2') }>
165	| RTapeUnitV :
166	    <{ tape () }> ⇛ <{ () }>
167	| RTapeBoxedLit b :
168	    <{ tape [b] }> ⇛ <{ [b] }>
169	| RTapeBoxedInj b ω v :
170	    otval ω -> oval v ->
171	    <{ tape [inj@b<ω> v] }> ⇛ <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>
172	
173	| RCgrPi l τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' L :
174	    τ1 ⇛ τ1' ->
175	    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ τ2^x }> ⇛ <{ τ2'^x }>) ->
176	    <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }> ⇛ <{ Π:{l}τ1', τ2' }>
177	| RCgrAbs l τ e τ' e' L :
178	    τ ⇛ τ' ->
179	    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ e^x }> ⇛ <{ e'^x }>) ->
180	    <{ \:{l}τ => e }> ⇛ <{ \:{l}τ' => e' }>
181	| RCgrApp e1 e2 e1' e2' :
182	    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
183	    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
184	    <{ e1 e2 }> ⇛ <{ e1' e2' }>
185	| RCgrLet e1 e2 e1' e2' L :
186	    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
187	    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
188	    <{ let e1 in e2 }> ⇛ <{ let e1' in e2' }>
189	| RCgrSec e e' :
190	    e ⇛ e' ->
191	    <{ s𝔹 e }> ⇛ <{ s𝔹 e' }>
192	| RCgrIf l e0 e1 e2 e0' e1' e2' :
193	    e0 ⇛ e0' ->
194	    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
195	    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
196	    <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }> ⇛ <{ if{l} e0' then e1' else e2' }>
197	| RCgrProd τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' :
198	    τ1 ⇛ τ1' ->
199	    τ2 ⇛ τ2' ->
200	    <{ τ1 * τ2 }> ⇛ <{ τ1' * τ2' }>
201	| RCgrPair e1 e2 e1' e2' :
202	    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
203	    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
204	    <{ (e1, e2) }> ⇛ <{ (e1', e2') }>
205	| RCgrProj b e e' :
206	    e ⇛ e' ->
207	    <{ π@b e }> ⇛ <{ π@b e' }>
208	| RCgrSum l τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' :
209	    τ1 ⇛ τ1' ->
210	    τ2 ⇛ τ2' ->
211	    <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }> ⇛ <{ τ1' +{l} τ2' }>
212	| RCgrInj l b τ e τ' e' :
213	    e ⇛ e' ->
214	    τ ⇛ τ' ->
215	    <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }> ⇛ <{ inj{l}@b<τ'> e' }>
216	| RCgrCase l e0 e1 e2 e0' e1' e2' L1 L2 :
217	    e0 ⇛ e0' ->
218	    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <{ e1^x }> ⇛ <{ e1'^x }>) ->
219	    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
220	    <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }> ⇛ <{ case{l} e0' of e1' | e2' }>
221	| RCgrFold X e e' :
222	    e ⇛ e' ->
223	    <{ fold<X> e }> ⇛ <{ fold<X> e' }>
224	| RCgrUnfold X e e' :
225	    e ⇛ e' ->
226	    <{ unfold<X> e }> ⇛ <{ unfold<X> e' }>
227	| RCgrMux e0 e1 e2 e0' e1' e2' :
228	    e0 ⇛ e0' ->
229	    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
230	    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
231	    <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }> ⇛ <{ mux e0' e1' e2' }>
232	| RCgrTape e e' :
233	    e ⇛ e' ->
234	    <{ tape e }> ⇛ <{ tape e' }>
235	
236	| RRefl e :
237	    lc e ->
238	    e ⇛ e
239	
240	where "e1 '⇛' e2" := (pared e1 e2)
241	.
242	
243	Notation "e '⇛*' e'" := (rtc pared e e')
244	                            (at level 40,
245	                             e' custom oadt at level 99).
246	
247	Inductive pared_equiv : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
248	| QRRefl e : e ≡ e
249	| QRRedL e1 e1' e2 :
250	    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
251	    e1' ≡ e2 ->
252	    e1 ≡ e2
253	| QRRedR e1 e2 e2' :
254	    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
255	    e1 ≡ e2' ->
256	    e1 ≡ e2
257	
258	where "e ≡ e'" := (pared_equiv e e')
259	.
260	
261	Definition pared_equiv_join (e1 e2 : expr) : Prop :=
262	  exists e, e1 ⇛* e /\ e2 ⇛* e.
263	
264	Reserved Notation "Γ '⊢' e ':{' l '}' τ" (at level 40,
265	                                          e custom oadt at level 99,
266	                                          l constr at level 99,
267	                                          τ custom oadt at level 99).
268	
269	Reserved Notation "Γ '⊢' τ '::' κ" (at level 40,
270	                                    τ custom oadt at level 99,
271	                                    κ custom oadt at level 99).
272	
273	Inductive typing : tctx -> expr -> bool -> expr -> Prop :=
274	| TFVar Γ x l τ κ :
275	    Γ !! x = Some (l, τ) ->
276	    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
277	    Γ ⊢ fvar x :{l} τ
278	| TUnit Γ : Γ ⊢ () :{⊥} 𝟙
279	| TLit Γ b : Γ ⊢ lit b :{⊥} 𝔹
280	| TFun Γ x l τ e :
281	    Σ !! x = Some (DFun (l, τ) e) ->
282	    Γ ⊢ gvar x :{l} τ
283	| TAbs Γ l1 l2 e τ1 τ2 κ L :
284	    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(l2, τ2)]>Γ ⊢ e^x :{l1} τ1^x) ->
285	    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: κ ->
286	    Γ ⊢ \:{l2}τ2 => e :{l1} (Π:{l2}τ2, τ1)
287	| TLet Γ l1 l2 l e1 e2 τ1 τ2 L :
288	    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ1 ->
289	    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(l1, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ e2^x :{l2} τ2^x) ->
290	    l = l1 ⊔ l2 ->
291	    Γ ⊢ let e1 in e2 :{l} τ2^e1
292	| TApp Γ l1 l2 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
293	    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} (Π:{l2}τ2, τ1) ->
294	    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ2 ->
295	    Γ ⊢ e1 e2 :{l1} τ1^e2
296	| TPair Γ l1 l2 l e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
297	    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ1 ->
298	    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ2 ->
299	    l = l1 ⊔ l2 ->
300	    Γ ⊢ (e1, e2) :{l} τ1 * τ2
301	| TProj Γ l b e τ1 τ2 :
302	    Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ1 * τ2 ->
303	    Γ ⊢ π@b e :{l} ite b τ1 τ2
304	| TInj Γ l b e τ1 τ2 κ :
305	    Γ ⊢ e :{l} ite b τ1 τ2 ->
306	    Γ ⊢ τ1 + τ2 :: κ ->
307	    Γ ⊢ inj@b<τ1 + τ2> e :{l} τ1 + τ2
308	| TIf Γ l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ κ :
309	    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} 𝔹 ->
310	    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ^(lit true) ->
311	    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ^(lit false) ->
312	    Γ ⊢ τ^e0 :: κ ->
313	    l = l1 ⊔ l2 ->
314	    Γ ⊢ if e0 then e1 else e2 :{l} τ^e0
315	| TIfNoDep Γ l0 l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ :
316	    Γ ⊢ e0 :{l0} 𝔹 ->
317	    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ ->
318	    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ ->
319	    l = l0 ⊔ l1 ⊔ l2 ->
320	    Γ ⊢ if e0 then e1 else e2 :{l} τ
321	| TCase Γ l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 :
322	    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} τ1 + τ2 ->
323	    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ e1^x :{l1} τ^(inl<τ1 + τ2> x)) ->
324	    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ2)]>Γ ⊢ e2^x :{l2} τ^(inr<τ1 + τ2> x)) ->
325	    Γ ⊢ τ^e0 :: κ ->
326	    l = l1 ⊔ l2 ->
327	    Γ ⊢ case e0 of e1 | e2 :{l} τ^e0
328	| TCaseNoDep Γ l0 l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 :
329	    Γ ⊢ e0 :{l0} τ1 + τ2 ->
330	    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(l0, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ e1^x :{l1} τ) ->
331	    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(l0, τ2)]>Γ ⊢ e2^x :{l2} τ) ->
332	    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
333	    l = l0 ⊔ l1 ⊔ l2 ->
334	    Γ ⊢ case e0 of e1 | e2 :{l} τ
335	| TFold Γ l X e τ :
336	    Σ !! X = Some (DADT τ) ->
337	    Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ ->
338	    Γ ⊢ fold<X> e :{l} gvar X
339	| TUnfold Γ l X e τ :
340	    Σ !! X = Some (DADT τ) ->
341	    Γ ⊢ e :{l} gvar X ->
342	    Γ ⊢ unfold<X> e :{l} τ
343	| TSec Γ l e :
344	    Γ ⊢ e :{l} 𝔹 ->
345	    Γ ⊢ s𝔹 e :{l} ~𝔹
346	| TMux Γ e0 e1 e2 τ :
347	    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} ~𝔹 ->
348	    Γ ⊢ e1 :{⊥} τ ->
349	    Γ ⊢ e2 :{⊥} τ ->
350	    Γ ⊢ τ :: *@O ->
351	    Γ ⊢ mux e0 e1 e2 :{⊥} τ
352	| TOInj Γ b e τ1 τ2 :
353	    Γ ⊢ e :{⊥} ite b τ1 τ2 ->
354	    Γ ⊢ τ1 ~+ τ2 :: *@O ->
355	    Γ ⊢ ~inj@b<τ1 ~+ τ2> e :{⊥} τ1 ~+ τ2
356	| TOIf Γ l1 l2 e0 e1 e2 τ κ :
357	    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} ~𝔹 ->
358	    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ ->
359	    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ ->
360	    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
361	    Γ ⊢ ~if e0 then e1 else e2 :{⊤} τ
362	| TOCase Γ l1 l2 e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 :
363	    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} τ1 ~+ τ2 ->
364	    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ e1^x :{l1} τ) ->
365	    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ2)]>Γ ⊢ e2^x :{l2} τ) ->
366	    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
367	    Γ ⊢ ~case e0 of e1 | e2 :{⊤} τ
368	| TTape Γ l e τ :
369	    Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ ->
370	    Γ ⊢ τ :: *@O ->
371	    Γ ⊢ tape e :{⊥} τ
372	
373	| TBoxedLit Γ b : Γ ⊢ [b] :{⊥} ~𝔹
374	| TBoxedInj Γ b v ω :
375	    ovalty <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }> ω ->
376	    Γ ⊢ [inj@b<ω> v] :{⊥} ω
377	
378	| TConv Γ l l' e τ τ' κ :
379	    Γ ⊢ e :{l'} τ' ->
380	    τ' ≡ τ ->
381	    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
382	    l' ⊑ l ->
383	    Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ
384	
385	with kinding : tctx -> expr -> kind -> Prop :=
386	| KADT Γ X τ :
387	    Σ !! X = Some (DADT τ) ->
388	    Γ ⊢ gvar X :: *@P
389	| KUnit Γ : Γ ⊢ 𝟙 :: *@A
390	| KBool Γ l : Γ ⊢ 𝔹{l} :: ite l *@O *@P
391	| KPi Γ l τ1 τ2 κ1 κ2 L :
392	    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(l, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ τ2^x :: κ2) ->
393	    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: κ1 ->
394	    Γ ⊢ (Π:{l}τ1, τ2) :: *@M
395	| KProd Γ τ1 τ2 κ :
396	    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: κ ->
397	    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: κ ->
398	    Γ ⊢ τ1 * τ2 :: κ
399	| KSum Γ τ1 τ2 κ :
400	    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: κ ->
401	    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: κ ->
402	    Γ ⊢ τ1 + τ2 :: (κ ⊔ *@P)
403	| KOSum Γ τ1 τ2 :
404	    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: *@O ->
405	    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: *@O ->
406	    Γ ⊢ τ1 ~+ τ2 :: *@O
407	| KOADT Γ e' e τ X :
408	    Σ !! X = Some (DOADT τ e') ->
409	    Γ ⊢ e :{⊥} τ ->
410	    Γ ⊢ (gvar X) e :: *@O
411	| KIf Γ e0 τ1 τ2 :
412	    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} 𝔹 ->
413	    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: *@O ->
414	    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: *@O ->
415	    Γ ⊢ if e0 then τ1 else τ2 :: *@O
416	| KCase Γ e0 τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' L1 L2 :
417	    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} τ1' + τ2' ->
418	    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ1')]>Γ ⊢ τ1^x :: *@O) ->
419	    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ2')]>Γ ⊢ τ2^x :: *@O) ->
420	    Γ ⊢ case e0 of τ1 | τ2 :: *@O
421	| KLet Γ e τ τ' L :
422	    Γ ⊢ e :{⊥} τ' ->
423	    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(⊥, τ')]>Γ ⊢ τ^x :: *@O) ->
424	    Γ ⊢ let e in τ :: *@O
425	| KSub Γ τ κ κ' :
426	    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ' ->
427	    κ' ⊑ κ ->
428	    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ
429	
430	where "Γ '⊢' e ':{' l '}' τ" := (typing Γ e l τ)
431	  and "Γ '⊢' τ '::' κ" := (kinding Γ τ κ)
432	.
433	
434	End fix_gctx.
435	
436	Scheme typing_kinding_ind := Minimality for typing Sort Prop
437	  with kinding_typing_ind := Minimality for kinding Sort Prop.
438	
439	Combined Scheme typing_kinding_mutind
440	         from typing_kinding_ind, kinding_typing_ind.
441	
442	Notation "Σ '⊢' e '≡' e'" := (pared_equiv Σ e e')
443	                               (at level 40,
444	                                e custom oadt at level 99,
445	                                e' custom oadt at level 99).
446	
447	Notation "Σ ; Γ '⊢' e ':{' l '}' τ" := (typing Σ Γ e l τ)
448	                                         (at level 40,
449	                                          Γ constr at level 0,
450	                                          e custom oadt at level 99,
451	                                          τ custom oadt at level 99,
452	                                          format "Σ ;  Γ  '⊢'  e  ':{' l '}'  τ").
453	
454	Notation "Σ ; Γ '⊢' τ '::' κ" := (kinding Σ Γ τ κ)
455	                                   (at level 40,
456	                                    Γ constr at level 0,
457	                                    τ custom oadt at level 99,
458	                                    κ custom oadt at level 99).
459	
460	Reserved Notation "Σ '⊢₁' D" (at level 40,
461	                               D constr at level 0).
462	
463	Inductive gdef_typing : gctx -> gdef -> Prop :=
464	| DTADT Σ τ :
465	    Σ; ∅ ⊢ τ :: *@P ->
466	    Σ ⊢₁ (DADT τ)
467	| DTOADT Σ τ e L :
468	    Σ; ∅ ⊢ τ :: *@P ->
469	    (forall x, x ∉ L -> Σ; ({[x:=(⊥, τ)]}) ⊢ e^x :: *@O) ->
470	    Σ ⊢₁ (DOADT τ e)
471	| DTFun Σ l τ e κ :
472	    Σ; ∅ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
473	    Σ; ∅ ⊢ e :{l} τ ->
474	    Σ ⊢₁ (DFun (l, τ) e)
475	
476	where "Σ '⊢₁' D" := (gdef_typing Σ D)
477	.
478	
479	Definition gctx_typing (Σ : gctx) : Prop :=
480	  map_Forall (fun _ D => Σ ⊢₁ D) Σ.
481	
482	Definition program_typing (Σ : gctx) (e : expr) (τ : expr) :=
483	  gctx_typing Σ /\ Σ; ∅ ⊢ e :{⊥} τ.
484	
485	End typing.
486	
487	Module notations.
488	
489	Export kind_notations.
490	
491	Notation "Σ '⊢' e '⇛' e'" := (pared Σ e e')
492	                                  (at level 40,
493	                                   e custom oadt at level 99,
494	                                   e' custom oadt at level 99).
495	
496	Notation "Σ '⊢' e '⇛*' e'" := (rtc (pared Σ) e e')
497	                                  (at level 40,
498	                                   e custom oadt at level 99,
499	                                   e' custom oadt at level 99).
500	
501	Notation "Σ '⊢' e '≡' e'" := (pared_equiv Σ e e')
502	                               (at level 40,
503	                                e custom oadt at level 99,
504	                                e' custom oadt at level 99).
505	
506	Notation "Σ ; Γ '⊢' e ':{' l '}' τ" := (typing Σ Γ e l τ)
507	                                         (at level 40,
508	                                          Γ constr at level 0,
509	                                          e custom oadt at level 99,
510	                                          l constr at level 99,
511	                                          τ custom oadt at level 99,
512	                                          format "Σ ;  Γ  '⊢'  e  ':{' l '}'  τ").
513	
514	Notation "Σ ; Γ '⊢' e ':' τ" := (typing Σ Γ e _ τ)
515	                                         (at level 40,
516	                                          Γ constr at level 0,
517	                                          e custom oadt at level 99,
518	                                          τ custom oadt at level 99,
519	                                          only parsing).
520	
521	Notation "Σ ; Γ '⊢' τ '::' κ" := (kinding Σ Γ τ κ)
522	                                   (at level 40,
523	                                    Γ constr at level 0,
524	                                    τ custom oadt at level 99,
525	                                    κ custom oadt at level 99).
526	
527	Notation "Σ '⊢₁' D" := (gdef_typing Σ D) (at level 40,
528	                                          D constr at level 0).
529	
530	Notation "Σ ; e '▷' τ" := (program_typing Σ e τ)
531	                            (at level 40,
532	                             e constr at level 0,
533	                             τ constr at level 0).

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.base.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.syntax.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.semantics.

Import syntax.notations.

Import semantics.notations.

Implicit Types (b : bool) (x X y Y : atom) (L : aset).

Variant kind :=
| KAny
| KPublic
| KObliv
| KMixed
.

Instance kind_join : Join kind :=
  fun κ1 κ2 =>
    match κ1, κ2 with
    | KAny, κ | κ, KAny => κ
    | KPublic, KObliv | KObliv, KPublic => KMixed
    | KMixed, _ | _, KMixed => KMixed
    | κ, _ => κ
    end.

Instance kind_le : SqSubsetEq kind :=
  fun κ1 κ2 => κ2 = (κ1 ⊔ κ2).

Instance kind_top : Top kind := KMixed.

Instance kind_bot : Bottom kind := KAny.

Notation tctx := (amap lexpr).

Module kind_notations.

Notation "*@A" := (KAny) (in custom oadt at level 0).

Notation "*@P" := (KPublic) (in custom oadt at level 0).

Notation "*@O" := (KObliv) (in custom oadt at level 0).

Notation "*@M" := (KMixed) (in custom oadt at level 0).

Infix "⊔" := (⊔) (in custom oadt at level 50).

End kind_notations.

Section typing.

Import kind_notations.

#[local]
Coercion EFVar : atom >-> expr.

Section fix_gctx.

Context (Σ : gctx).

Reserved Notation "e '⇛' e'" (at level 40,
                                 e' constr at level 0).

Inductive pared : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
| RApp l τ e1 e2 e1' e2' L :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    lc τ ->
    <{ (\:{l}τ => e2) e1 }> ⇛ <{ e2'^e1' }>
| RFun x T e :
    Σ !! x = Some (DFun T e) ->
    <{ gvar x }> ⇛ <{ e }>
| ROADT X τ' τ e e' :
    Σ !! X = Some (DOADT τ' τ) ->
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ (gvar X) e }> ⇛ <{ τ^e' }>
| RLet e1 e2 e1' e2' L :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    <{ let e1 in e2 }> ⇛ <{ e2'^e1' }>
| RProj b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ π@b (e1, e2) }> ⇛ <{ ite b e1' e2' }>
| RFold X X' e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ unfold<X> (fold<X'> e) }> ⇛ e'
| RIf b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ if b then e1 else e2 }> ⇛ <{ ite b e1' e2' }>
| RCase b τ e0 e1 e2 e0' e1' e2' L1 L2 :
    e0 ⇛ e0' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <{ e1^x }> ⇛ <{ e1'^x }>) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    lc τ ->
    <{ case inj@b<τ> e0 of e1 | e2 }> ⇛ <{ ite b (e1'^e0') (e2'^e0') }>

| RMux b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ mux [b] e1 e2 }> ⇛ <{ ite b e1' e2' }>
| RSec b :
    <{ s𝔹 b }> ⇛ <{ [b] }>
| ROInj b ω v :
    otval ω -> oval v ->
    <{ ~inj@b<ω> v }> ⇛ <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>

| ROIf b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ ~if [b] then e1 else e2 }> ⇛ <{ ite b e1' e2' }>
| ROCase b ω1 ω2 v v1 v2 e1 e2 e1' e2' L1 L2 :
    oval v ->
    ovalty v1 ω1 -> ovalty v2 ω2 ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <{ e1^x }> ⇛ <{ e1'^x }>) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    <{ ~case [inj@b<ω1 ~+ ω2> v] of e1 | e2 }> ⇛
      <{ ~if [b] then (ite b (e1'^v) (e1'^v1)) else (ite b (e2'^v2) (e2'^v)) }>

| ROIfApp b e1 e2 e e1' e2' e' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ (~if [b] then e1 else e2) e }> ⇛ <{ ~if [b] then e1' e' else e2' e' }>
| ROIfSec b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ s𝔹 (~if [b] then e1 else e2) }> ⇛ <{ ~if [b] then s𝔹 e1' else s𝔹 e2' }>
| ROIfIf b e1 e2 e3 e4 e1' e2' e3' e4' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    e3 ⇛ e3' ->
    e4 ⇛ e4' ->
    <{ if (~if [b] then e1 else e2) then e3 else e4 }> ⇛
      <{ ~if [b] then (if e1' then e3' else e4') else (if e2' then e3' else e4') }>
| ROIfProj b b' e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ π@b' (~if [b] then e1 else e2) }> ⇛
      <{ ~if [b] then π@b' e1' else π@b' e2' }>
| ROIfCase b e1 e2 e3 e4 e1' e2' e3' e4' L1 L2 :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <{ e3^x }> ⇛ <{ e3'^x }>) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <{ e4^x }> ⇛ <{ e4'^x }>) ->
    <{ case (~if [b] then e1 else e2) of e3 | e4 }> ⇛
      <{ ~if [b] then (case e1' of e3' | e4') else (case e2' of e3' | e4') }>
| ROIfUnfold X b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ unfold<X> (~if [b] then e1 else e2) }> ⇛
      <{ ~if [b] then unfold<X> e1' else unfold<X> e2' }>
| RTapeOIf b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ tape (~if [b] then e1 else e2) }> ⇛ <{ mux [b] (tape e1') (tape e2') }>
| RTapePair e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    woval e1 -> woval e2 ->
    <{ tape (e1, e2) }> ⇛ <{ (tape e1', tape e2') }>
| RTapeUnitV :
    <{ tape () }> ⇛ <{ () }>
| RTapeBoxedLit b :
    <{ tape [b] }> ⇛ <{ [b] }>
| RTapeBoxedInj b ω v :
    otval ω -> oval v ->
    <{ tape [inj@b<ω> v] }> ⇛ <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>

| RCgrPi l τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' L :
    τ1 ⇛ τ1' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ τ2^x }> ⇛ <{ τ2'^x }>) ->
    <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }> ⇛ <{ Π:{l}τ1', τ2' }>
| RCgrAbs l τ e τ' e' L :
    τ ⇛ τ' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ e^x }> ⇛ <{ e'^x }>) ->
    <{ \:{l}τ => e }> ⇛ <{ \:{l}τ' => e' }>
| RCgrApp e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ e1 e2 }> ⇛ <{ e1' e2' }>
| RCgrLet e1 e2 e1' e2' L :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    <{ let e1 in e2 }> ⇛ <{ let e1' in e2' }>
| RCgrSec e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ s𝔹 e }> ⇛ <{ s𝔹 e' }>
| RCgrIf l e0 e1 e2 e0' e1' e2' :
    e0 ⇛ e0' ->
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }> ⇛ <{ if{l} e0' then e1' else e2' }>
| RCgrProd τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' :
    τ1 ⇛ τ1' ->
    τ2 ⇛ τ2' ->
    <{ τ1 * τ2 }> ⇛ <{ τ1' * τ2' }>
| RCgrPair e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ (e1, e2) }> ⇛ <{ (e1', e2') }>
| RCgrProj b e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ π@b e }> ⇛ <{ π@b e' }>
| RCgrSum l τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' :
    τ1 ⇛ τ1' ->
    τ2 ⇛ τ2' ->
    <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }> ⇛ <{ τ1' +{l} τ2' }>
| RCgrInj l b τ e τ' e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    τ ⇛ τ' ->
    <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }> ⇛ <{ inj{l}@b<τ'> e' }>
| RCgrCase l e0 e1 e2 e0' e1' e2' L1 L2 :
    e0 ⇛ e0' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <{ e1^x }> ⇛ <{ e1'^x }>) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }> ⇛ <{ case{l} e0' of e1' | e2' }>
| RCgrFold X e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ fold<X> e }> ⇛ <{ fold<X> e' }>
| RCgrUnfold X e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ unfold<X> e }> ⇛ <{ unfold<X> e' }>
| RCgrMux e0 e1 e2 e0' e1' e2' :
    e0 ⇛ e0' ->
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }> ⇛ <{ mux e0' e1' e2' }>
| RCgrTape e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ tape e }> ⇛ <{ tape e' }>

| RRefl e :
    lc e ->
    e ⇛ e

where "e1 '⇛' e2" := (pared e1 e2)
.

Notation "e '⇛*' e'" := (rtc pared e e')
                            (at level 40,
                             e' custom oadt at level 99).

Inductive pared_equiv : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
| QRRefl e : e ≡ e
| QRRedL e1 e1' e2 :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e1' ≡ e2 ->
    e1 ≡ e2
| QRRedR e1 e2 e2' :
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    e1 ≡ e2' ->
    e1 ≡ e2

where "e ≡ e'" := (pared_equiv e e')
.

Definition pared_equiv_join (e1 e2 : expr) : Prop :=
  exists e, e1 ⇛* e /\ e2 ⇛* e.

Reserved Notation "Γ '⊢' e ':{' l '}' τ" (at level 40,
                                          e custom oadt at level 99,
                                          l constr at level 99,
                                          τ custom oadt at level 99).

Reserved Notation "Γ '⊢' τ '::' κ" (at level 40,
                                    τ custom oadt at level 99,
                                    κ custom oadt at level 99).

Inductive typing : tctx -> expr -> bool -> expr -> Prop :=
| TFVar Γ x l τ κ :
    Γ !! x = Some (l, τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ fvar x :{l} τ
| TUnit Γ : Γ ⊢ () :{⊥} 𝟙
| TLit Γ b : Γ ⊢ lit b :{⊥} 𝔹
| TFun Γ x l τ e :
    Σ !! x = Some (DFun (l, τ) e) ->
    Γ ⊢ gvar x :{l} τ
| TAbs Γ l1 l2 e τ1 τ2 κ L :
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(l2, τ2)]>Γ ⊢ e^x :{l1} τ1^x) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ \:{l2}τ2 => e :{l1} (Π:{l2}τ2, τ1)
| TLet Γ l1 l2 l e1 e2 τ1 τ2 L :
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ1 ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(l1, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ e2^x :{l2} τ2^x) ->
    l = l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ let e1 in e2 :{l} τ2^e1
| TApp Γ l1 l2 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} (Π:{l2}τ2, τ1) ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ2 ->
    Γ ⊢ e1 e2 :{l1} τ1^e2
| TPair Γ l1 l2 l e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ1 ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ2 ->
    l = l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ (e1, e2) :{l} τ1 * τ2
| TProj Γ l b e τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ1 * τ2 ->
    Γ ⊢ π@b e :{l} ite b τ1 τ2
| TInj Γ l b e τ1 τ2 κ :
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} ite b τ1 τ2 ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 + τ2 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ inj@b<τ1 + τ2> e :{l} τ1 + τ2
| TIf Γ l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ κ :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} 𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ^(lit true) ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ^(lit false) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ^e0 :: κ ->
    l = l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ if e0 then e1 else e2 :{l} τ^e0
| TIfNoDep Γ l0 l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{l0} 𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ ->
    l = l0 ⊔ l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ if e0 then e1 else e2 :{l} τ
| TCase Γ l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} τ1 + τ2 ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ e1^x :{l1} τ^(inl<τ1 + τ2> x)) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ2)]>Γ ⊢ e2^x :{l2} τ^(inr<τ1 + τ2> x)) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ^e0 :: κ ->
    l = l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ case e0 of e1 | e2 :{l} τ^e0
| TCaseNoDep Γ l0 l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{l0} τ1 + τ2 ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(l0, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ e1^x :{l1} τ) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(l0, τ2)]>Γ ⊢ e2^x :{l2} τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    l = l0 ⊔ l1 ⊔ l2 ->
    Γ ⊢ case e0 of e1 | e2 :{l} τ
| TFold Γ l X e τ :
    Σ !! X = Some (DADT τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ fold<X> e :{l} gvar X
| TUnfold Γ l X e τ :
    Σ !! X = Some (DADT τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} gvar X ->
    Γ ⊢ unfold<X> e :{l} τ
| TSec Γ l e :
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} 𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ s𝔹 e :{l} ~𝔹
| TMux Γ e0 e1 e2 τ :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} ~𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{⊥} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{⊥} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ mux e0 e1 e2 :{⊥} τ
| TOInj Γ b e τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ e :{⊥} ite b τ1 τ2 ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 ~+ τ2 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ ~inj@b<τ1 ~+ τ2> e :{⊥} τ1 ~+ τ2
| TOIf Γ l1 l2 e0 e1 e2 τ κ :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} ~𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ e1 :{l1} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ e2 :{l2} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ ~if e0 then e1 else e2 :{⊤} τ
| TOCase Γ l1 l2 e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} τ1 ~+ τ2 ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ e1^x :{l1} τ) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ2)]>Γ ⊢ e2^x :{l2} τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ ~case e0 of e1 | e2 :{⊤} τ
| TTape Γ l e τ :
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ tape e :{⊥} τ

| TBoxedLit Γ b : Γ ⊢ [b] :{⊥} ~𝔹
| TBoxedInj Γ b v ω :
    ovalty <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }> ω ->
    Γ ⊢ [inj@b<ω> v] :{⊥} ω

| TConv Γ l l' e τ τ' κ :
    Γ ⊢ e :{l'} τ' ->
    τ' ≡ τ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    l' ⊑ l ->
    Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ

with kinding : tctx -> expr -> kind -> Prop :=
| KADT Γ X τ :
    Σ !! X = Some (DADT τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ gvar X :: *@P
| KUnit Γ : Γ ⊢ 𝟙 :: *@A
| KBool Γ l : Γ ⊢ 𝔹{l} :: ite l *@O *@P
| KPi Γ l τ1 τ2 κ1 κ2 L :
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(l, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ τ2^x :: κ2) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: κ1 ->
    Γ ⊢ (Π:{l}τ1, τ2) :: *@M
| KProd Γ τ1 τ2 κ :
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 * τ2 :: κ
| KSum Γ τ1 τ2 κ :
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 + τ2 :: (κ ⊔ *@P)
| KOSum Γ τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 ~+ τ2 :: *@O
| KOADT Γ e' e τ X :
    Σ !! X = Some (DOADT τ e') ->
    Γ ⊢ e :{⊥} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ (gvar X) e :: *@O
| KIf Γ e0 τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} 𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ if e0 then τ1 else τ2 :: *@O
| KCase Γ e0 τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' L1 L2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} τ1' + τ2' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ1')]>Γ ⊢ τ1^x :: *@O) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ2')]>Γ ⊢ τ2^x :: *@O) ->
    Γ ⊢ case e0 of τ1 | τ2 :: *@O
| KLet Γ e τ τ' L :
    Γ ⊢ e :{⊥} τ' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(⊥, τ')]>Γ ⊢ τ^x :: *@O) ->
    Γ ⊢ let e in τ :: *@O
| KSub Γ τ κ κ' :
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ' ->
    κ' ⊑ κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ

where "Γ '⊢' e ':{' l '}' τ" := (typing Γ e l τ)
  and "Γ '⊢' τ '::' κ" := (kinding Γ τ κ)
.

End fix_gctx.

Scheme typing_kinding_ind := Minimality for typing Sort Prop
  with kinding_typing_ind := Minimality for kinding Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme typing_kinding_mutind
         from typing_kinding_ind, kinding_typing_ind.

Notation "Σ '⊢' e '≡' e'" := (pared_equiv Σ e e')
                               (at level 40,
                                e custom oadt at level 99,
                                e' custom oadt at level 99).

Notation "Σ ; Γ '⊢' e ':{' l '}' τ" := (typing Σ Γ e l τ)
                                         (at level 40,
                                          Γ constr at level 0,
                                          e custom oadt at level 99,
                                          τ custom oadt at level 99,
                                          format "Σ ;  Γ  '⊢'  e  ':{' l '}'  τ").

Notation "Σ ; Γ '⊢' τ '::' κ" := (kinding Σ Γ τ κ)
                                   (at level 40,
                                    Γ constr at level 0,
                                    τ custom oadt at level 99,
                                    κ custom oadt at level 99).

Reserved Notation "Σ '⊢₁' D" (at level 40,
                               D constr at level 0).

Inductive gdef_typing : gctx -> gdef -> Prop :=
| DTADT Σ τ :
    Σ; ∅ ⊢ τ :: *@P ->
    Σ ⊢₁ (DADT τ)
| DTOADT Σ τ e L :
    Σ; ∅ ⊢ τ :: *@P ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> Σ; ({[x:=(⊥, τ)]}) ⊢ e^x :: *@O) ->
    Σ ⊢₁ (DOADT τ e)
| DTFun Σ l τ e κ :
    Σ; ∅ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
    Σ; ∅ ⊢ e :{l} τ ->
    Σ ⊢₁ (DFun (l, τ) e)

where "Σ '⊢₁' D" := (gdef_typing Σ D)
.

Definition gctx_typing (Σ : gctx) : Prop :=
  map_Forall (fun _ D => Σ ⊢₁ D) Σ.

Definition program_typing (Σ : gctx) (e : expr) (τ : expr) :=
  gctx_typing Σ /\ Σ; ∅ ⊢ e :{⊥} τ.

End typing.

Module notations.

Export kind_notations.

Notation "Σ '⊢' e '⇛' e'" := (pared Σ e e')
                                  (at level 40,
                                   e custom oadt at level 99,
                                   e' custom oadt at level 99).

Notation "Σ '⊢' e '⇛*' e'" := (rtc (pared Σ) e e')
                                  (at level 40,
                                   e custom oadt at level 99,
                                   e' custom oadt at level 99).

Notation "Σ '⊢' e '≡' e'" := (pared_equiv Σ e e')
                               (at level 40,
                                e custom oadt at level 99,
                                e' custom oadt at level 99).

Notation "Σ ; Γ '⊢' e ':{' l '}' τ" := (typing Σ Γ e l τ)
                                         (at level 40,
                                          Γ constr at level 0,
                                          e custom oadt at level 99,
                                          l constr at level 99,
                                          τ custom oadt at level 99,
                                          format "Σ ;  Γ  '⊢'  e  ':{' l '}'  τ").

Notation "Σ ; Γ '⊢' e ':' τ" := (typing Σ Γ e _ τ)
                                         (at level 40,
                                          Γ constr at level 0,
                                          e custom oadt at level 99,
                                          τ custom oadt at level 99,
                                          only parsing).

Notation "Σ ; Γ '⊢' τ '::' κ" := (kinding Σ Γ τ κ)
                                   (at level 40,
                                    Γ constr at level 0,

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.base.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.syntax.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.semantics.

From oadt Require Import lang_oadt.typing.

From stdpp Require Import stringmap.

Import syntax.notations.

Import semantics.notations.

Import typing.notations.

Implicit Types (b : bool) (x X y Y : atom) (L : aset).

Definition trace_indistinguishable Σ e1 e2 : Prop :=
  forall n e1',
    Σ ⊨ e1 -->{n} e1' ->
    (exists e2', Σ ⊨ e2 -->{n} e2') /\
    (forall e2', Σ ⊨ e2 -->{n} e2' -> e1' ≈ e2').

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Free variables                                                     *)
(* ================================================================ *)
Fixpoint fv (e : expr) : aset :=
  match e with
  | EBVar _ => ∅
  | EFVar x => {[x]}
  | EGVar _ => ∅
  | EUnitT => ∅
  | EUnitV => ∅
  | EBool _ => ∅
  | ELit _ => ∅
  | EProd τ1 τ2 => fv τ1 ∪ fv τ2
  | ESum _ τ1 τ2 => fv τ1 ∪ fv τ2
  | EPi _ τ1 τ2 => fv τ1 ∪ fv τ2
  | EAbs _ τ e => fv τ ∪ fv e
  | EApp e1 e2 => fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | ELet e1 e2 => fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EIte _ e0 e1 e2 => fv e0 ∪ fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EPair e1 e2 => fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EProj _ e => fv e
  | EInj _ _ τ e => fv τ ∪ fv e
  | ECase _ e0 e1 e2 => fv e0 ∪ fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EFold _ e => fv e
  | EUnfold _ e => fv e
  | ESec e => fv e
  | ETape e => fv e
  | EMux e0 e1 e2 => fv e0 ∪ fv e1 ∪ fv e2
  | EBoxedLit _ => ∅
  | EBoxedInj _ τ e => fv τ ∪ fv e
  end.

Lemma fv_subst_le x s e : fv (subst x s e) ⊆ fv s ∪ fv e.
Proof.
  induction e; simpl; try set_solver.
  case_decide; simpl; set_solver.
...
  - split; [by apply IHlc|].
    apply (lc_n_open τ2 (fresh_string_of_set EmptyString L) 0). apply H0. apply fresh_string_of_set_fresh.
  - split; [by apply IHlc|].
    apply (lc_n_open e (fresh_string_of_set EmptyString L) 0). apply H0. apply fresh_string_of_set_fresh.
  - split; [by apply IHlc|].
    apply (lc_n_open e2 (fresh_string_of_set EmptyString L) 0). apply H0. apply fresh_string_of_set_fresh.
  - repeat split.
    + by apply IHlc.
    + apply (lc_n_open e1 (fresh_string_of_set EmptyString L1) 0). apply H0. apply fresh_string_of_set_fresh.
    + apply (lc_n_open e2 (fresh_string_of_set EmptyString L2) 0). apply H2. apply fresh_string_of_set_fresh.
  - split; [by apply otval_lc_n0|by apply oval_lc_n0].
Qed.

Lemma map_insert_subset_mono (Γ Γ' : tctx) x T :
  Γ ⊆ Γ' -> <[x:=T]>Γ ⊆ <[x:=T]>Γ'.
Proof.
  intros H. rewrite map_subseteq_spec in H. rewrite map_subseteq_spec.
  intros k w Hk.
  destruct (decide (x = k)) as [->|Hne].
  - rewrite lookup_insert_eq in Hk. simplify_eq. exact (lookup_insert_eq Γ' k w).
  - rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hk by done. rewrite lookup_insert_ne by done.

Proof.

Lemma typing_kinding_weaken Σ :
  (forall (Γ : tctx) e l τ, Σ; Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ ->
     forall Γ', Γ ⊆ Γ' -> Σ; Γ' ⊢ e :{l} τ) /\
  (forall (Γ : tctx) τ κ, Σ; Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
     forall Γ', Γ ⊆ Γ' -> Σ; Γ' ⊢ τ :: κ).
Proof.
  apply typing_kinding_mutind.
  - (* TFVar *) intros Γ x l τ κ Hlk Hk IH Γ' Hsub. econstructor.
    + rewrite map_subseteq_spec in Hsub. by apply (Hsub x (l,τ) Hlk).
    + by apply IH.
  - (* TUnit *) intros; econstructor.
  - (* TLit *) intros; econstructor.
  - (* TFun *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TAbs *) intros Γ l1 l2 e τ1 τ2 κ L Hbody IHbody Hk IHk Γ' Hsub.
    econstructor; eauto using map_insert_subset_mono.
  - (* TLet *) intros Γ l1 l2 l e1 e2 τ1 τ2 L He1 IHe1 Hbody IHbody Hl Γ' Hsub.
    econstructor; eauto using map_insert_subset_mono.
  - (* TApp *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TPair *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TProj *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TInj *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TIf *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TIfNoDep *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TCase *) intros Γ l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 H0 IH0 Hb1 IHb1 Hb2 IHb2 Hk IHk Hl Γ' Hsub.
    econstructor; eauto using map_insert_subset_mono.
  - (* TCaseNoDep *) intros Γ l0 l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 H0 IH0 Hb1 IHb1 Hb2 IHb2 Hk IHk Hl Γ' Hsub.
    econstructor; eauto using map_insert_subset_mono.
  - (* TFold *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TUnfold *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TSec *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TMux *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TOInj *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TOIf *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TOCase *) intros Γ l1 l2 e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 H0 IH0 Hb1 IHb1 Hb2 IHb2 Hk IHk Γ' Hsub.
    econstructor; eauto using map_insert_subset_mono.
  - (* TTape *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TBoxedLit *) intros; econstructor.
  - (* TBoxedInj *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TConv *) intros Γ l l' e τ τ' κ He IHe Hpe Hk IHk Hle Γ' Hsub.
    econstructor; eauto.
  - (* KADT *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* KUnit *) intros; econstructor.
  - (* KBool *) intros; econstructor.
  - (* KPi *) intros Γ l τ1 τ2 κ1 κ2 L Hbody IHbody Hk IHk Γ' Hsub.
    econstructor; eauto using map_insert_subset_mono.
  - (* KProd *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* KSum *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* KOSum *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* KOADT *) intros; econstructor; eauto.

Qed.

Lemma typing_weaken Σ Γ e l τ (H : Σ; Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ) Γ' (Hsub : Γ ⊆ Γ') :

Proof. exact (proj2 (typing_kinding_weaken Σ) Γ τ κ H Γ' Hsub). Qed.

Lemma typing_kinding_weaken Σ :
  (forall (Γ : tctx) e l τ, Σ; Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ ->
     forall Γ', Γ ⊆ Γ' -> Σ; Γ' ⊢ e :{l} τ) /\
  (forall (Γ : tctx) τ κ, Σ; Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
     forall Γ', Γ ⊆ Γ' -> Σ; Γ' ⊢ τ :: κ).
Proof.
  apply typing_kinding_mutind.
  - (* TFVar *) intros Γ x l τ κ Hlk Hk IH Γ' Hsub. econstructor.
    + rewrite map_subseteq_spec in Hsub. by apply (Hsub x (l,τ) Hlk).
    + by apply IH.
  - (* TUnit *) intros; econstructor.
  - (* TLit *) intros; econstructor.
  - (* TFun *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TAbs *) intros Γ l1 l2 e τ1 τ2 κ L Hbody IHbody Hk IHk Γ' Hsub.
    econstructor; eauto using map_insert_subset_mono.
  - (* TLet *) intros Γ l1 l2 l e1 e2 τ1 τ2 L He1 IHe1 Hbody IHbody Hl Γ' Hsub.
    econstructor; eauto using map_insert_subset_mono.
  - (* TApp *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TPair *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TProj *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TInj *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TIf *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TIfNoDep *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TCase *) intros Γ l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 H0 IH0 Hb1 IHb1 Hb2 IHb2 Hk IHk Hl Γ' Hsub.
    econstructor; eauto using map_insert_subset_mono.
  - (* TCaseNoDep *) intros Γ l0 l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 H0 IH0 Hb1 IHb1 Hb2 IHb2 Hk IHk Hl Γ' Hsub.
    econstructor; eauto using map_insert_subset_mono.
  - (* TFold *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TUnfold *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TSec *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TMux *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TOInj *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TOIf *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TOCase *) intros Γ l1 l2 e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 H0 IH0 Hb1 IHb1 Hb2 IHb2 Hk IHk Γ' Hsub.
    econstructor; eauto using map_insert_subset_mono.
  - (* TTape *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TBoxedLit *) intros; econstructor.
  - (* TBoxedInj *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* TConv *) intros Γ l l' e τ τ' κ He IHe Hpe Hk IHk Hle Γ' Hsub.
    econstructor; eauto.
  - (* KADT *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* KUnit *) intros; econstructor.
  - (* KBool *) intros; econstructor.
  - (* KPi *) intros Γ l τ1 τ2 κ1 κ2 L Hbody IHbody Hk IHk Γ' Hsub.
    econstructor; eauto using map_insert_subset_mono.
  - (* KProd *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* KSum *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* KOSum *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* KOADT *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* KIf *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
  - (* KCase *) intros Γ e0 τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' L1 L2 H0 IH0 Hb1 IHb1 Hb2 IHb2.
    econstructor; eauto using map_insert_subset_mono.
  - (* KLet *) intros Γ e τ τ' L He IHe Hb IHb.
    econstructor; eauto using map_insert_subset_mono.
  - (* KSub *) intros; econstructor; eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Locally closed (no free bvars) at depth n                          *)
(* ================================================================ *)
Fixpoint lc_n (n : nat) (e : expr) : Prop :=
  match e with
  | EBVar k => k < n
  | EFVar _ => True
  | EGVar _ => True
  | EUnitT => True
  | EUnitV => True
  | EBool _ => True
  | ELit _ => True
  | EProd τ1 τ2 => lc_n n τ1 /\ lc_n n τ2
  | ESum _ τ1 τ2 => lc_n n τ1 /\ lc_n n τ2
  | EPi _ τ1 τ2 => lc_n n τ1 /\ lc_n (S n) τ2
  | EAbs _ τ e => lc_n n τ /\ lc_n (S n) e
  | EApp e1 e2 => lc_n n e1 /\ lc_n n e2
  | ELet e1 e2 => lc_n n e1 /\ lc_n (S n) e2
  | EIte _ e0 e1 e2 => lc_n n e0 /\ lc_n n e1 /\ lc_n n e2
  | EPair e1 e2 => lc_n n e1 /\ lc_n n e2
  | EProj _ e => lc_n n e
  | EInj _ _ τ e => lc_n n τ /\ lc_n n e
  | ECase _ e0 e1 e2 => lc_n n e0 /\ lc_n (S n) e1 /\ lc_n (S n) e2
  | EFold _ e => lc_n n e
  | EUnfold _ e => lc_n n e
  | ESec e => lc_n n e
  | ETape e => lc_n n e
  | EMux e0 e1 e2 => lc_n n e0 /\ lc_n n e1 /\ lc_n n e2
  | EBoxedLit _ => True
  | EBoxedInj _ τ e => lc_n n τ /\ lc_n n e
  end.

  forall jj, nn <= jj -> forall ss, open_ jj ss e = e.

  induction e; intros nn Hn jj Hj ss; simpl in *; try done;
  try (destruct Hn as [? [? ?]]); try (destruct Hn as [? ?]).
  all: try (repeat f_equal).
  all: try (eauto using le_n_S).
  all: try (case_decide; [exfalso; lia|done]).
Qed.

Lemma lc_n_mono : forall (e:expr) (nn mm:nat), lc_n nn e -> nn <= mm -> lc_n mm e.

  all: try (destruct H as [? [? ?]]).
  all: try (destruct H as [? ?]).

Ltac pb xx vv Hn E E' IH L :=
  let y := fresh "y" in
  intros y Hy;
  let Hyx := fresh "Hyx" in assert (Hyx : xx ≠ y) by (intros ->; apply Hy; set_solver);
  let He1 := fresh "He1" in
  assert (He1 : open (EFVar y) (subst xx vv E) = subst xx vv (open (EFVar y) E))
    by (symmetry; rewrite (subst_open_open xx vv (EFVar y) E Hn);
        by rewrite (subst_fvar_neq xx vv y Hyx));
  let He2 := fresh "He2" in
  assert (He2 : open (EFVar y) (subst xx vv E') = subst xx vv (open (EFVar y) E'))
    by (symmetry; rewrite (subst_open_open xx vv (EFVar y) E' Hn);
        by rewrite (subst_fvar_neq xx vv y Hyx));
  rewrite He1, He2;
  apply (IH y); set_solver.

  foldr (fun p acc => gdef_fv (p.2) ∪ acc) ∅ (map_to_list Σ).

Lemma pared_subst Σ xx vv (Hv : lc vv) (HΣ : xx ∉ gctx_fv Σ) :
  forall e e', pared Σ e e' -> pared Σ (subst xx vv e) (subst xx vv e').
Proof.
  assert (Hn : lc_n 0 vv) by (apply lc_lc_n0; auto).
  intros e e' H. induction H.
  - (* RApp *) simpl. rewrite (subst_open_open xx vv e1' e2' Hn).
    eapply RApp with (L := L ∪ {[xx]}).
    + exact IHpared.
    + pb xx vv Hn e2 e2' H1 L.
    + apply lc_subst; auto.
  - (* RFun *) simpl.
    assert (Hx : xx ∉ gdef_fv (DFun T e)) by (apply (gctx_fv_notin Σ x (DFun T e) xx); auto).
    simpl in Hx. assert (Hfe : xx ∉ fv e) by set_solver.
    rewrite (subst_not_fv xx vv e Hfe). exact (RFun Σ x T e H).
  - (* ROADT *) simpl.
    assert (Hx : xx ∉ gdef_fv (DOADT τ' τ)) by (apply (gctx_fv_notin Σ X (DOADT τ' τ) xx); auto).
    simpl in Hx. assert (Hfτ : xx ∉ fv τ) by set_solver.
    rewrite (subst_open_open xx vv e' τ Hn).
    rewrite (subst_not_fv xx vv τ Hfτ).
    exact (ROADT Σ X τ' τ (subst xx vv e) (subst xx vv e') H IHpared).
  - (* RLet *) simpl. rewrite (subst_open_open xx vv e1' e2' Hn).
    eapply RLet with (L := L ∪ {[xx]}).
    + exact IHpared.
    + pb xx vv Hn e2 e2' H1 L.
  - (* RProj *) destruct b; simpl;
      [ eapply RProj with (b := true) | eapply RProj with (b := false) ]; eauto.
  - (* RFold *) simpl. eapply RFold. exact IHpared.
  - (* RIf *) destruct b; simpl;

Lemma typing_kinding_subst Σ xx vv (Hv : lc vv) (HΣ : xx ∉ gctx_fv Σ) :
  (forall Γ e l τ, Σ; Γ ⊢ e :{l} τ ->
     forall Γ0 lx τx,
       Γ = <[xx:=(lx,τx)]>Γ0 ->
       xx ∉ dom Γ0 ->
       Σ; tctx_subst xx vv Γ0 ⊢ vv :{lx} <{ {xx ↦ vv} τx }> ->
       Σ; tctx_subst xx vv Γ ⊢ subst xx vv e :{l} subst xx vv τ) /\
  (forall Γ τ κ, Σ; Γ ⊢ τ :: κ ->
     forall Γ0 lx τx,
       Γ = <[xx:=(lx,τx)]>Γ0 ->
       xx ∉ dom Γ0 ->
       Σ; tctx_subst xx vv Γ0 ⊢ vv :{lx} <{ {xx ↦ vv} τx }> ->
       Σ; tctx_subst xx vv Γ ⊢ subst xx vv τ :: κ).
Proof.
  assert (Hn : lc_n 0 vv) by (apply lc_lc_n0; auto).
  apply typing_kinding_mutind.
  - (* TFVar *)
    intros Γ x l τ κ Hlk Hk IHk Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv.
    destruct (decide (x = xx)) as [Heqx|Hne].
    + subst x.
      rewrite Heq in Hlk. rewrite lookup_insert_eq in Hlk. simplify_eq.
      rewrite subst_fvar_eq.
      rewrite Heq, tctx_subst_insert_self.
      eapply typing_weaken; [exact Hvv|].
      apply map_subset_insert. apply not_elem_dom_tctx_subst. exact Hdom.
    + assert (Hne' : xx <> x) by (intros H; apply Hne; symmetry; exact H).
      rewrite (subst_fvar_neq xx vv x Hne').
      apply (TFVar Σ (tctx_subst xx vv Γ) x l (subst xx vv τ) κ).
      * by rewrite tctx_subst_lookup, Hlk.
      * apply (IHk Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv).
  - (* TUnit *)
    intros Γ Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv.
    apply (TUnit Σ (tctx_subst xx vv Γ)).
  - (* TLit *)
    intros Γ b Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv.
    apply (TLit Σ (tctx_subst xx vv Γ) b).
  - (* TFun *)
    intros Γ x l τ e Hdef Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv.
    assert (Hnot : xx ∉ fv τ) by
      (intros Hx; apply HΣ; apply (gctx_fv_spec Σ x (DFun (l,τ) e) xx Hdef); simpl; set_solver).
    rewrite (subst_not_fv xx vv τ Hnot).
    apply (TFun Σ (tctx_subst xx vv Γ) x l τ e Hdef).
  - (* TAbs *)
    intros Γ l1 l2 e τ1 τ2 κ L Hbody IHbody Hk IHk Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv.
    apply (TAbs Σ (tctx_subst xx vv Γ) l1 l2 (subst xx vv e) (subst xx vv τ1) (subst xx vv τ2) κ (L ∪ dom Γ0 ∪ {[xx]})).
    + tsub_bind_fvar Σ xx vv Hn Γ Γ0 lx τx Hvv Hdom l2 τ2 e τ1 IHbody (L ∪ dom Γ0 ∪ {[xx]}).
    + apply (IHk Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv).
  - (* TLet *)

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Free variables of a typing context                                 *)
(* ================================================================ *)
Definition tctx_fv (Γ : tctx) : aset :=
  foldr (fun p acc => fv (snd (p.2)) ∪ acc) ∅ (map_to_list Γ).

Lemma elem_of_tctx_fv_aux (l : list (atom * lexpr)) x :
  (exists p, p ∈ l /\ x ∈ fv (snd (p.2))) ->
  x ∈ foldr (fun p acc => fv (snd (p.2)) ∪ acc) ∅ l.
Proof.
  induction l as [|p l IH]; simpl; intros [q [Hin Hx]].
  - inversion Hin.
  - apply elem_of_cons in Hin as [->|Hin].
    + by apply elem_of_union_l.
    + apply elem_of_union_r. by apply IH; exists q.
Qed.

Lemma tctx_fv_spec Γ y (T : lexpr) : Γ !! y = Some T -> fv (snd T) ⊆ tctx_fv Γ.
Proof.
  intros H Hx. unfold tctx_fv.
  apply elem_of_tctx_fv_aux. exists (y,T). split; [|done].
  by apply elem_of_map_to_list.
Qed.

Lemma tctx_subst_id x s Γ : x ∉ tctx_fv Γ -> tctx_subst x s Γ = Γ.
Proof.
  intros H. apply map_eq. intros y.
  rewrite tctx_subst_lookup.
  destruct (Γ !! y) as [[l τ]|] eqn:E; simpl.
  - f_equal. apply subst_not_fv. intros Hx.
    apply H. exact (tctx_fv_spec Γ y (l,τ) E Hx).
  - done.
Qed.

Lemma subst_open_same x v e : lc_n 0 v -> x ∉ fv e ->
  subst x v (open (EFVar x) e) = open v e.
Proof.
  intros Hv Hf.
  rewrite (subst_open_comm_lc e x v 0 (EFVar x) Hv).
  rewrite (subst_fvar_eq x v).
  by rewrite (subst_not_fv x v e Hf).
Qed.
EOF

    + apply (IH0 Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv).
    + tsub_bind_case Σ xx vv Hn Γ Γ0 lx τx Hvv Hdom Heq true τ1 τ2 (⊥ : bool) τ1 e1 τ IHb1 L1.
    + tsub_bind_case Σ xx vv Hn Γ Γ0 lx τx Hvv Hdom Heq false τ1 τ2 (⊥ : bool) τ2 e2 τ IHb2 L2.
    + rewrite <- (subst_open_open xx vv e0 τ Hn).
      apply (IHk Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv).

  - (* TCaseNoDep *)
    intros Γ l0 l1 l2 l e0 e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ κ L1 L2 H0 IH0 Hb1 IHb1 Hb2 IHb2 Hk IHk Hl Γ0 lx τx Heq Hdom Hvv.
    apply (TCaseNoDep Σ (tctx_subst xx vv Γ) l0 l1 l2 l (subst xx vv e0) (subst xx vv e1) (subst xx vv e2) (subst xx vv τ1) (subst xx vv τ2) (subst xx vv τ) κ (L1 ∪ dom Γ0 ∪ {[xx]}) (L2 ∪ dom Γ0 ∪ {[xx]})).

Lemma subst_ite x s (b : bool) e1 e2 :
  subst x s (if b then e1 else e2) = (if b then subst x s e1 else subst x s e2).
Proof. intros. by destruct b. Qed.

(* Binder helper: dependent body and type. *)
Ltac tsub_bind_fvar Σ xx vv Hn Γ Γ0 lx τx Hvv Hdom Heq l T E Ety IHbody L :=
  let y := fresh "y" in intros y Hy;
  let Hyx := fresh "Hyx" in assert (Hyx : xx <> y) by (intros ->; apply Hy; set_solver);
  let HyL := fresh "HyL" in assert (HyL : y ∉ L) by set_solver;
  let Hydom := fresh "Hydom" in assert (Hydom : y ∉ dom Γ0) by set_solver;
  rewrite <- (subst_open_fvar_lc2 xx vv y E Hn Hyx);
  rewrite <- (subst_open_fvar_lc2 xx vv y Ety Hn Hyx);
  rewrite <- (tctx_subst_insert2 xx vv y l T Γ Hyx);
  set (Γ0' := <[y:=(l,T)]>Γ0);
  assert (Heq' : <[y:=(l,T)]>Γ = <[xx:=(lx,τx)]>Γ0')
    by (rewrite Heq; subst Γ0'; apply (map_insert_swap y xx (l,T) (lx,τx) Γ0);
        intros H; apply Hyx; symmetry; exact H);
  assert (Hdom' : xx ∉ dom Γ0') by (subst Γ0'; rewrite dom_insert; set_solver);
  assert (Hvv' : (Σ; (tctx_subst xx vv Γ0') ⊢ vv :{lx} <{ {xx ↦ vv} τx }>))
    by (subst Γ0'; eapply typing_weaken; [exact Hvv|];
        rewrite (tctx_subst_insert2 xx vv y l T Γ0 Hyx);
        apply map_subset_insert; apply not_elem_dom_tctx_subst; exact Hydom);
  apply (IHbody y HyL Γ0' lx τx Heq' Hdom' Hvv').

(* Binder helper: non-dependent type. *)
Ltac tsub_bind_fvar_nd Σ xx vv Hn Γ Γ0 lx τx Hvv Hdom Heq l T E IHbody L :=
  let y := fresh "y" in intros y Hy;
  let Hyx := fresh "Hyx" in assert (Hyx : xx <> y) by (intros ->; apply Hy; set_solver);
  let HyL := fresh "HyL" in assert (HyL : y ∉ L) by set_solver;

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Beta substitution (single-variable, closed value)                  *)
(* ================================================================ *)
Lemma typing_subst_beta Σ Γ x v l2 τ2 e l τ :
  x ∉ gctx_fv Σ -> lc v ->
  x ∉ dom Γ -> x ∉ tctx_fv Γ -> x ∉ fv τ2 -> x ∉ fv e -> x ∉ fv τ ->
  Σ; Γ ⊢ v :{l2} τ2 ->
  Σ; <[x:=(l2,τ2)]>Γ ⊢ open (EFVar x) e :{l} open (EFVar x) τ ->
  Σ; Γ ⊢ open v e :{l} open v τ.
Proof.
  intros HΣ Hv Hdom Htfv Hτ2 He Hτ Htyv Hbody.
  assert (Hn : lc_n 0 v) by (apply lc_lc_n0; auto).
  assert (Hvv : Σ; (tctx_subst x v Γ) ⊢ v :{l2} subst x v τ2).
  { rewrite (tctx_subst_id x v Γ Htfv), (subst_not_fv x v τ2 Hτ2). exact Htyv. }
  pose proof (proj1 (typing_kinding_subst Σ x v Hv HΣ)
    (<[x:=(l2,τ2)]>Γ) (open (EFVar x) e) l (open (EFVar x) τ)
    Hbody Γ l2 τ2 eq_refl Hdom Hvv) as Hres.
  rewrite (tctx_subst_id x v Γ Htfv) in Hres.
  rewrite (subst_open_same x v e Hn He) in Hres.
  rewrite (subst_open_same x v τ Hn Hτ) in Hres.
  exact Hres.
Qed.

Lemma kinding_subst_beta Σ Γ x v l2 τ2 T κ :
  x ∉ gctx_fv Σ -> lc v ->
  x ∉ dom Γ -> x ∉ tctx_fv Γ -> x ∉ fv τ2 -> x ∉ fv T ->

  Σ; <[x:=(l2,τ2)]>Γ ⊢ open (EFVar x) T :: κ ->
  Σ; Γ ⊢ open v T :: κ.
Proof.

  assert (Hn : lc_n 0 v) by (apply lc_lc_n0; auto).
  assert (Hvv : Σ; (tctx_subst x v Γ) ⊢ v :{l2} subst x v τ2).
  { rewrite (tctx_subst_id x v Γ Htfv), (subst_not_fv x v τ2 Hτ2). exact Htyv. }

    (<[x:=(l2,τ2)]>Γ) (open (EFVar x) T) κ
    Hbody Γ l2 τ2 eq_refl Hdom Hvv) as Hres.

  rewrite (subst_open_same x v T Hn HT) in Hres.

with kinding : tctx -> expr -> kind -> Prop :=
| KADT Γ X τ :
    Σ !! X = Some (DADT τ) ->
    Γ ⊢ gvar X :: *@P
| KUnit Γ : Γ ⊢ 𝟙 :: *@A
| KBool Γ l : Γ ⊢ 𝔹{l} :: ite l *@O *@P
| KPi Γ l τ1 τ2 κ1 κ2 L :
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <[x:=(l, τ1)]>Γ ⊢ τ2^x :: κ2) ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: κ1 ->
    Γ ⊢ (Π:{l}τ1, τ2) :: *@M
| KProd Γ τ1 τ2 κ :
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 * τ2 :: κ
| KSum Γ τ1 τ2 κ :
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: κ ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 + τ2 :: (κ ⊔ *@P)
| KOSum Γ τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 ~+ τ2 :: *@O
| KOADT Γ e' e τ X :
    Σ !! X = Some (DOADT τ e') ->
    Γ ⊢ e :{⊥} τ ->
    Γ ⊢ (gvar X) e :: *@O
| KIf Γ e0 τ1 τ2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} 𝔹 ->
    Γ ⊢ τ1 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ τ2 :: *@O ->
    Γ ⊢ if e0 then τ1 else τ2 :: *@O
| KCase Γ e0 τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' L1 L2 :
    Γ ⊢ e0 :{⊥} τ1' + τ2' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ1')]>Γ ⊢ τ1^x :: *@O) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <[x:=(⊥, τ2')]>Γ ⊢ τ2^x :: *@O) ->
    Γ ⊢ case e0 of τ1 | τ2 :: *@O

    Γ ⊢ let e in τ :: *@O

    Γ ⊢ τ :: κ' ->

#[local]
Coercion EFVar : atom >-> expr.

Section fix_gctx.

Context (Σ : gctx).

Reserved Notation "e '⇛' e'" (at level 40,
                                 e' constr at level 0).

Inductive pared : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
| RApp l τ e1 e2 e1' e2' L :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    lc τ ->
    <{ (\:{l}τ => e2) e1 }> ⇛ <{ e2'^e1' }>
| RFun x T e :
    Σ !! x = Some (DFun T e) ->
    <{ gvar x }> ⇛ <{ e }>
| ROADT X τ' τ e e' :
    Σ !! X = Some (DOADT τ' τ) ->
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ (gvar X) e }> ⇛ <{ τ^e' }>
| RLet e1 e2 e1' e2' L :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    <{ let e1 in e2 }> ⇛ <{ e2'^e1' }>
| RProj b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ π@b (e1, e2) }> ⇛ <{ ite b e1' e2' }>
| RFold X X' e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ unfold<X> (fold<X'> e) }> ⇛ e'
| RIf b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ if b then e1 else e2 }> ⇛ <{ ite b e1' e2' }>
| RCase b τ e0 e1 e2 e0' e1' e2' L1 L2 :
    e0 ⇛ e0' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <{ e1^x }> ⇛ <{ e1'^x }>) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    lc τ ->
    <{ case inj@b<τ> e0 of e1 | e2 }> ⇛ <{ ite b (e1'^e0') (e2'^e0') }>

| RMux b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ mux [b] e1 e2 }> ⇛ <{ ite b e1' e2' }>
| RSec b :
    <{ s𝔹 b }> ⇛ <{ [b] }>
| ROInj b ω v :
    otval ω -> oval v ->
    <{ ~inj@b<ω> v }> ⇛ <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>

| ROIf b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ ~if [b] then e1 else e2 }> ⇛ <{ ite b e1' e2' }>
| ROCase b ω1 ω2 v v1 v2 e1 e2 e1' e2' L1 L2 :
    oval v ->
    ovalty v1 ω1 -> ovalty v2 ω2 ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <{ e1^x }> ⇛ <{ e1'^x }>) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    <{ ~case [inj@b<ω1 ~+ ω2> v] of e1 | e2 }> ⇛
      <{ ~if [b] then (ite b (e1'^v) (e1'^v1)) else (ite b (e2'^v2) (e2'^v)) }>

| ROIfApp b e1 e2 e e1' e2' e' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ (~if [b] then e1 else e2) e }> ⇛ <{ ~if [b] then e1' e' else e2' e' }>
| ROIfSec b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ s𝔹 (~if [b] then e1 else e2) }> ⇛ <{ ~if [b] then s𝔹 e1' else s𝔹 e2' }>
| ROIfIf b e1 e2 e3 e4 e1' e2' e3' e4' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    e3 ⇛ e3' ->
    e4 ⇛ e4' ->
    <{ if (~if [b] then e1 else e2) then e3 else e4 }> ⇛
      <{ ~if [b] then (if e1' then e3' else e4') else (if e2' then e3' else e4') }>
| ROIfProj b b' e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ π@b' (~if [b] then e1 else e2) }> ⇛
      <{ ~if [b] then π@b' e1' else π@b' e2' }>
| ROIfCase b e1 e2 e3 e4 e1' e2' e3' e4' L1 L2 :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <{ e3^x }> ⇛ <{ e3'^x }>) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <{ e4^x }> ⇛ <{ e4'^x }>) ->
    <{ case (~if [b] then e1 else e2) of e3 | e4 }> ⇛
      <{ ~if [b] then (case e1' of e3' | e4') else (case e2' of e3' | e4') }>
| ROIfUnfold X b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ unfold<X> (~if [b] then e1 else e2) }> ⇛
      <{ ~if [b] then unfold<X> e1' else unfold<X> e2' }>
| RTapeOIf b e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ tape (~if [b] then e1 else e2) }> ⇛ <{ mux [b] (tape e1') (tape e2') }>
| RTapePair e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    woval e1 -> woval e2 ->
    <{ tape (e1, e2) }> ⇛ <{ (tape e1', tape e2') }>
| RTapeUnitV :
    <{ tape () }> ⇛ <{ () }>
| RTapeBoxedLit b :
    <{ tape [b] }> ⇛ <{ [b] }>
| RTapeBoxedInj b ω v :
    otval ω -> oval v ->
    <{ tape [inj@b<ω> v] }> ⇛ <{ [inj@b<ω> v] }>

| RCgrPi l τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' L :
    τ1 ⇛ τ1' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ τ2^x }> ⇛ <{ τ2'^x }>) ->
    <{ Π:{l}τ1, τ2 }> ⇛ <{ Π:{l}τ1', τ2' }>
| RCgrAbs l τ e τ' e' L :
    τ ⇛ τ' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ e^x }> ⇛ <{ e'^x }>) ->
    <{ \:{l}τ => e }> ⇛ <{ \:{l}τ' => e' }>
| RCgrApp e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ e1 e2 }> ⇛ <{ e1' e2' }>
| RCgrLet e1 e2 e1' e2' L :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    <{ let e1 in e2 }> ⇛ <{ let e1' in e2' }>
| RCgrSec e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ s𝔹 e }> ⇛ <{ s𝔹 e' }>
| RCgrIf l e0 e1 e2 e0' e1' e2' :
    e0 ⇛ e0' ->
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ if{l} e0 then e1 else e2 }> ⇛ <{ if{l} e0' then e1' else e2' }>
| RCgrProd τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' :
    τ1 ⇛ τ1' ->
    τ2 ⇛ τ2' ->
    <{ τ1 * τ2 }> ⇛ <{ τ1' * τ2' }>
| RCgrPair e1 e2 e1' e2' :
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ (e1, e2) }> ⇛ <{ (e1', e2') }>
| RCgrProj b e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ π@b e }> ⇛ <{ π@b e' }>
| RCgrSum l τ1 τ2 τ1' τ2' :
    τ1 ⇛ τ1' ->
    τ2 ⇛ τ2' ->
    <{ τ1 +{l} τ2 }> ⇛ <{ τ1' +{l} τ2' }>
| RCgrInj l b τ e τ' e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    τ ⇛ τ' ->
    <{ inj{l}@b<τ> e }> ⇛ <{ inj{l}@b<τ'> e' }>
| RCgrCase l e0 e1 e2 e0' e1' e2' L1 L2 :
    e0 ⇛ e0' ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L1 -> <{ e1^x }> ⇛ <{ e1'^x }>) ->
    (forall x, x ∉ L2 -> <{ e2^x }> ⇛ <{ e2'^x }>) ->
    <{ case{l} e0 of e1 | e2 }> ⇛ <{ case{l} e0' of e1' | e2' }>
| RCgrFold X e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ fold<X> e }> ⇛ <{ fold<X> e' }>
| RCgrUnfold X e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ unfold<X> e }> ⇛ <{ unfold<X> e' }>
| RCgrMux e0 e1 e2 e0' e1' e2' :
    e0 ⇛ e0' ->
    e1 ⇛ e1' ->
    e2 ⇛ e2' ->
    <{ mux e0 e1 e2 }> ⇛ <{ mux e0' e1' e2' }>
| RCgrTape e e' :
    e ⇛ e' ->
    <{ tape e }> ⇛ <{ tape e' }>

| RRefl e :
    lc e ->
    e ⇛ e

where "e1 '⇛' e2" := (pared e1 e2)
.

Notation "e '⇛*' e'" := (rtc pared e e')

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Free variables of a typing context                                 *)
(* ================================================================ *)
Definition tctx_fv (Γ : tctx) : aset :=
  foldr (fun p acc => fv (snd (p.2)) ∪ acc) ∅ (map_to_list Γ).

Lemma elem_of_tctx_fv_aux (l : list (atom * lexpr)) x :
  (exists p, p ∈ l /\ x ∈ fv (snd (p.2))) ->
  x ∈ foldr (fun p acc => fv (snd (p.2)) ∪ acc) ∅ l.
Proof.
  induction l as [|p l IH]; simpl; intros [q [Hin Hx]].
  - inversion Hin.
  - apply elem_of_cons in Hin as [->|Hin].
    + by apply elem_of_union_l.
    + apply elem_of_union_r. by apply IH; exists q.
Qed.

Lemma tctx_fv_spec Γ y (T : lexpr) : Γ !! y = Some T -> fv (snd T) ⊆ tctx_fv Γ.
Proof.
  intros H x0 Hx. unfold tctx_fv.
  apply elem_of_tctx_fv_aux. exists (y,T). split; [|done].
  by apply elem_of_map_to_list.
Qed.

Lemma tctx_subst_id x s Γ : x ∉ tctx_fv Γ -> tctx_subst x s Γ = Γ.
Proof.
  intros H. apply map_eq. intros y.
  rewrite tctx_subst_lookup.
  destruct (Γ !! y) as [[l τ]|] eqn:E.
  - rewrite fmap_Some. exists (l,τ). split; [exact E|].
    simpl. f_equal. symmetry. apply subst_not_fv. intros Hx.
    apply H. exact ((tctx_fv_spec Γ y (l,τ) E) x Hx).
  - rewrite fmap_None. done.
Qed.

Lemma subst_open_same x v e : lc_n 0 v -> x ∉ fv e ->
  subst x v (open (EFVar x) e) = open v e.
Proof.
  intros Hv Hf.
  change (subst x v (open_ 0 (EFVar x) e) = open_ 0 v e).
  rewrite (subst_open_comm_lc e x v 0 (EFVar x) Hv).
  rewrite (subst_fvar_eq x v).
  by rewrite (subst_not_fv x v e Hf).
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Oblivious type forms are kinded *@O                                *)
(* ================================================================ *)
Lemma otval_kinding Σ Γ w : otval w -> Σ; Γ ⊢ w :: *@O.
Proof.
  induction 1.
  - apply (KSub Σ Γ EUnitT KObliv KAny). apply KUnit. done.
  - apply (KBool Σ Γ true).
  - apply (KProd Σ Γ ω1 ω2 KObliv); assumption.
  - apply (KOSum Σ Γ ω1 ω2); assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ovalty_kinding Σ Γ v ω : ovalty v ω -> Σ; Γ ⊢ ω :: *@O.
Proof.
  induction 1.
  - apply (KSub Σ Γ EUnitT KObliv KAny). apply KUnit. done.
  - apply (KBool Σ Γ true).
  - apply (KProd Σ Γ ω1 ω2 KObliv).
    + apply otval_kinding. apply (ovalty_otval v1 ω1 H).
    + apply otval_kinding. apply (ovalty_otval v2 ω2 H0).
  - destruct b; apply (KOSum Σ Γ ω1 ω2).
    + apply otval_kinding. eapply ovalty_otval. exact H.
    + apply otval_kinding. exact H0.
    + apply otval_kinding. exact H0.
    + apply otval_kinding. eapply ovalty_otval. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma otval_ite_kinding Σ Γ b ω1 ω2 : otval ω1 -> otval ω2 ->
  kinding Σ Γ (if b then ω1 else ω2) KObliv.
Proof.
  intros H1 H2. destruct b; simpl.
  - apply otval_kinding; assumption.
  - apply otval_kinding; assumption.
Qed.

(* ================================================================ *)
(* Conversion has common reducts                                      *)
(* ================================================================ *)
Lemma pared_equiv_common Σ e e' : pared_equiv Σ e e' ->
  exists c, rtc (pared Σ) e c /\ rtc (pared Σ) e' c.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H.
  - exists e. split; apply rtc_refl.
  - destruct IHpared_equiv as [c [H1 H2]].
    exists c. split; [|exact H2].
    eapply rtc_trans; [|exact H1]. apply rtc_once. exact H.
  - destruct IHpared_equiv as [c [H1 H2]].
    exists c. split; [exact H1|].
    eapply rtc_trans; [|exact H2]. apply rtc_once. exact H.
Qed.

Proof.

  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal; [apply IHHc1; assumption|apply IHHc2; assumption].
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal; [apply IHHc1; assumption|apply IHHc2; assumption].
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Proof.
  intros Hc Hrtc.
  refine (rtc_ind_r (fun z => canonical e -> z = e) e _ _ e' Hrtc Hc).
  - intros _. reflexivity.
  - intros y z Hr Hyz IH Hce.
    rewrite (IH Hce) in Hyz.
    apply (canonical_pared Σ e Hce z Hyz).
Qed.

Proof.

  destruct (pared_equiv_common Σ a b H) as [c [H1 H2]].
  transitivity c.
  - symmetry. apply (canonical_rtc Σ a c Ha H1).
  - apply (canonical_rtc Σ b c Hb H2).

Proof.
  induction 1.
  - apply CUnitT.
  - apply CBool.
  - apply CProd; assumption.
  - apply CSum; assumption.
Qed.
